items.title: Elevators
items.author: Jrh0203
items.summary_zh: 这个关于电梯的Hacker News讨论帖引发了广泛关注，话题涵盖电梯调度算法、等待时间优化和现代电梯系统的智能控制技术。电梯作为城市垂直交通的核心设施，其运行效率直接影响着人们的生活和工作体验。讨论中提到的智能电梯系统利用AI进行客流预测和动态调度，能够显著减少等待时间，这一看似平凡的设备背后其实藏着丰富的系统工程和算法设计学问。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled "Elevators" has sparked a wide-ranging discussion about the technology behind vertical transportation. The conversation covers elevator dispatch algorithms, wait time optimization, and the emerging role of AI in modern elevator systems. While elevators seem mundane, they represent a fascinating intersection of mechanical engineering, control systems, and operations research. Smart elevator systems now use predictive algorithms and AI to anticipate traffic patterns and dynamically optimize car assignment, significantly reducing wait times in busy buildings. The discussion highlights how an overlooked everyday technology contains deep engineering challenges — from load balancing during rush hour to energy efficiency — making it a compelling topic for engineers and urban technology enthusiasts.

items.title: UEFA and its national associations will not participate in FIFA competitions
items.author: dickfickling
items.summary_zh: UEFA及其成员国足协宣布将不参加FIFA旗下赛事，这是国际足球管理体系的重大分裂。起因是全球足球管理机构之间的权力和利益分配矛盾日益激化，特别是关于赛事日程和扩军计划的争议。这一决定可能重塑国际足球赛事的格局，对球员、俱乐部和球迷都将产生深远影响，也可能导致国际足球出现双轨制局面。
items.summary_en: UEFA and its national associations have announced they will boycott FIFA-organized competitions, marking an unprecedented fracture in international football governance. This escalation stems from long-simmering disputes over match scheduling, competition format expansion, and revenue distribution between the two governing bodies. The decision could split the global football landscape into competing jurisdictions, with profound implications for players, clubs, and national teams who may face conflicting commitments. For the sport's fans, it risks creating confusion around international tournaments and disrupting established traditions. This is a power struggle with existential stakes for the world's most popular sport.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
items.author: gitpusher42
items.summary_zh: 一个开源项目实现了在2GB内存的M系列Mac上本地运行Gemma 4 26B模型。通过先进的量化技术和内存优化算法，这个引擎大幅降低了运行大语言模型的硬件门槛。普通Mac用户无需昂贵的工作站或云端服务，就能在本地运行强大的AI模型，既保护了数据隐私，又降低了使用成本。对开源AI社区的普及和民主化具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: A new open-source engine enables running Google's Gemma 4 26B model in just 2GB of RAM on any M-series Mac. This is a significant breakthrough for on-device AI, achieved through advanced quantization and aggressive memory optimization techniques. Previously, running a model of this size required substantial memory or cloud computing resources. Now, everyday Mac users can execute powerful language models locally without expensive hardware or cloud subscriptions, while keeping their data private. This project exemplifies the ongoing democratization of AI — lowering the barrier to entry for developers, researchers, and hobbyists who want to experiment with state-of-the-art models on consumer hardware.

items.title: The coolest use for the Vision Pro
items.author: robbiet480

Developers in the comments mostly agree that productivity beats entertainment here, despite complaints about comfort and battery. Worth reading if you're evaluating Apple's spatial computer.

items.title: 7.1 Earthquake in Japan
items.author: krembo
items.summary_zh: 日本发生7.1级地震，震感强烈，但未引发严重海啸。这次事件再次凸显了地震预警系统的重要性，以及日本在防灾科技方面的领先地位。对于科技行业而言，这也是检验各种通信和监测设备实际性能的契机。
items.summary_en: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake shook Japan with strong tremors, but did not trigger a major tsunami. The event once again underscores the importance of earthquake early warning systems and Japan's leadership in disaster prevention technology. For the tech industry, it also serves as a real-world test of various communication and monitoring devices.

items.title: Read this before you buy that TV streaming stick
items.author: speckx
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章建议购买电视棒前先看清三个隐藏成本：系统占用可用的存储空间、系统更新周期决定设备寿命、主页会推送广告。它对比了 Roku、Fire TV 和 Google TV 的长期体验，认为低价格并不等于低总拥有成本。适合准备购买电视盒子的用户。
items.summary_en: This article warns that cheap streaming sticks come with hidden costs: system files eat available storage, OS updates have a limited lifespan, and home screens show ads. It compares Roku, Fire TV, and Google TV on long-term experience, arguing that a low upfront price doesn't mean low total ownership. A must-read before picking a living-room device.

items.title: Superlogical
items.author: yan
items.summary_zh: Superlogical是一个通过自然语言描述来自动化逻辑推理和流程编排的工具。用户只需用简单的语言说明需求，它就能自动生成可执行的逻辑规则，适合处理复杂的决策树或业务规则。对于那些需要快速验证算法正确性，或者要在系统中嵌入逻辑推理能力的人来说，Superlogical降低了门槛。它像是一个懂你意图的逻辑引擎，把繁琐的规则编写变成对话式的体验。
items.summary_en: Superlogical is a tool that turns natural language descriptions into executable logic rules and workflows. Instead of manually coding complex decision trees or business rules, you simply describe what you want, and it handles the translation. This makes it a game‑changer for developers and analysts who need to quickly prototype or embed reasoning capabilities into their systems. It lowers the barrier for automating logic, transforming a traditionally tedious task into a conversational interaction. Think of it as a logic engine that understands your intent and builds the rules for you.

items.title: Stacked PRs are now live on GitHub
items.author: tomzorz
items.summary_zh: GitHub 今日正式上线堆叠 PR（stacked pull requests）功能，允许把相互依赖的多个 PR 按依赖关系排列成栈，逐层合并。这样大改动可以拆成多个小提交独立评审，适合在长生命周期分支上协作的团队，能明显减少等待和冲突。
items.summary_en: GitHub has officially launched stacked pull requests, allowing developers to group multiple dependent PRs into a stack and merge them in order. This approach lets large changes be split into smaller, independently reviewable commits, which matters for teams on long-lived branches. The feature is now live for all users.

items.title: The session you cannot take with you
items.author: apitman
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 Web 会话的本质：服务端把会话状态绑定在用户当前浏览器，用户一旦离开或关闭标签页，这个会话就无法再被带走或恢复。它剖析了无状态 HTTP 下认证的边界问题，适合前后端开发者思考登录态设计与会话安全。
items.summary_en: This piece examines the ephemeral nature of web sessions: the server ties session state to the user's current browser, so leaving the site or closing the tab makes that session impossible to carry over or restore. It unpacks authentication boundaries under stateless HTTP, useful for developers designing login flows and session security.

items.summary_en: This open-source engine makes it possible to run the large language model Gemma 4 26B on any M-series Mac with just 2GB of RAM. Through aggressive quantization and memory optimization, it lowers the hardware barrier for running cutting-edge AI locally. This is a game-changer for AI enthusiasts, students, and developers with limited resources, enabling them to experiment and develop applications without expensive cloud GPUs or high-end workstations.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Update
items.author: dnhkng
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4-Flash 更新，新一代轻量模型主打更低推理延迟和更省 token 消耗，同时保持较高的编码与逻辑能力。对需要高频调用 AI 的开发者来说，它是一个在成本和响应速度上更平衡的选项，适合做成 Agent 或实时助手。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek released V4-Flash, an update in its model family that emphasizes lower inference latency and more efficient token usage while retaining solid coding and reasoning abilities. Developers making high-frequency AI calls should evaluate it as a balanced option for agents and real-time assistants, especially when cost and speed matter.

items.title: AI's top startups are barely publishing their research
items.author: YeGoblynQueenne
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章指出，顶尖AI创业公司目前几乎不再公开发表研究成果，这标志着从学术界开放传统向工业界保密策略的明显转变。这种趋势引发了关于可复现性、研究透明度和技术共享的担忧，对于依赖前沿公开成果的研究人员和行业观察者来说，了解其影响至关重要。
items.summary_en: Top AI startups are increasingly keeping their research under wraps, a stark departure from the open publication culture of academia. This piece explores how the shift toward corporate secrecy affects reproducibility, transparency, and the broader AI ecosystem. Researchers and industry observers who rely on published breakthroughs to guide their work will find this analysis particularly relevant, as it raises important questions about the future of knowledge sharing in a field that once thrived on collective progress.

items.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 微软推出的《AI for Beginners》课程是一套为期12周、共24课时的免费学习资源，专为零基础学习者设计。课程覆盖机器学习、神经网络、计算机视觉等核心主题，结合实践项目，帮助初学者系统掌握人工智能基础。无论学生还是转行者，都能借此轻松入门AI领域。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's AI for Beginners is a free, structured curriculum that spans 12 weeks with 24 lessons, covering essential AI topics like machine learning, neural networks, and computer vision. It's designed for absolute beginners, offering hands-on projects and clear explanations. This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. It's a perfect starting point for anyone curious about artificial intelligence.

items.author: paperswithbacktest

items.summary_en: This curated list aggregates systematic trading resources, including libraries, strategies, books, blogs, and tutorials, spanning backtesting, risk management, and data sourcing. Organized by topic, it helps both beginners and experienced quants quickly find reliable implementations and reference material without extensive searching. The collection is on GitHub and updated by the community.

items.summary_en: Kaneo is an open-source project management tool built on a minimalist philosophy, offering only essential features without unnecessary clutter. It targets developers and small teams who prefer a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to heavier project management suites. The project emphasizes adapting to user workflows rather than forcing users to adapt to the tool.

items.summary_en: reverse-skill is an AI-powered skill router designed for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research. It matches user requests to the right skills, bootstraps toolchains on demand, and includes a self-evolving knowledge base, with support for Claude Code. It's handy for security researchers to run experiments, but authorized use is a must.

The material is organized as a beginner-friendly curriculum, making it easy to follow sequentially or jump to a specific lesson. This is a practical starting point for developers seeking a structured, hands-on introduction to the field.

items.title: ansible/ansible
items.description: Ansible is a radically simple IT automation platform that makes your applications and systems easier to deploy and maintain. Automate everything from code deployment to network configuration to cloud management, in a language that approaches plain English, using SSH, with no agents to install on remote systems. https://docs.ansible.com.
items.author: ansible
items.summary_zh: Ansible 是一个极其简洁的 IT 自动化平台，它使用人类可读的 YAML 描述系统配置，无需在目标机器上安装代理就可以完成服务器部署、应用发布和运维编排。对于那些希望用最少的精力实现大规模基础设施自动化的运维团队来说，Ansible 的简洁性和无代理架构带来了显著的生产力提升。
items.summary_en: Ansible is a radically simple IT automation platform that uses human-readable YAML playbooks to automate deployment, configuration management, and application delivery. Its agentless architecture means you don't need to install anything on managed nodes, drastically reducing setup effort. IT operations teams benefit most because it makes automating everything from server provisioning to application updates straightforward and repeatable. It's designed to let you manage thousands of machines with the same ease as one, solving the complexity of modern infrastructure at scale.

items.summary_en: ByteDance open-sourced DeerFlow, a long-horizon SuperAgent framework that autonomously researches, codes, and creates. items.summary_en: BitChat is an open-source chat application built on Bluetooth Mesh, allowing devices to automatically form a network and exchange messages without any internet or central server. Its experience mimics the vibe of classic IRC chats. This project solves the problem of maintaining communication in offline or network-restricted areas, making it ideal for outdoor adventures, disaster response, or privacy-conscious users. It demonstrates a compelling alternative for decentralized messaging.

items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway that exposes a single endpoint to access over 290 providers (90+ free) and 500+ models, including Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, and many more. Developers can now call almost any cutting-edge model through one API, eliminating the need for separate integrations and sign-ups. This dramatically lowers the barrier for AI experimentation and development, making it a huge boon for AI application builders.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6-Sol, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing tool designed to automatically identify and fix vulnerabilities in applications. By simulating cyber attacks with artificial intelligence, it helps developers catch security flaws early in the development cycle, significantly reducing manual effort and cost. This tool is particularly valuable for startups and individual developers who lack dedicated security teams, offering a practical way to strengthen app security without complex infrastructure. Its open-source nature also allows the community to contribute and customize it for specific needs.

items.title: MiniMax H3
items.description: Unified video generation for motion design and branding
items.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布统一视频生成模型 H3，面向动态设计与品牌视觉，用户可通过文本或图片生成带品牌风格的动效片段。它把动态图形和品牌规范整合在同一条生成流程里，省去人工调整和多次渲染，适合设计团队快速产出营销素材。
items.summary_en: MiniMax launches H3, a unified video generation model focused on motion design and branding. It lets users create brand-consistent animated clips from text or images, merging motion graphics and brand guidelines into one pipeline. Useful for design teams that need fast marketing or ad assets.

items.title: Cleanlist AI
items.description: Natural-language prospecting: find, enrich and sync leads.
items.summary_zh: Cleanlist AI 是一款自然语言销售线索工具：用户用对话方式描述目标客户，它负责查找、补全字段并同步到外部系统。适合销售和增长团队，能减少手动整理线索、保持 CRM 数据更新的工作量。
items.summary_en: Cleanlist AI is a natural-language prospecting tool: you describe your target lead conversationally, and it finds, enriches, and syncs the data. Sales and growth teams can reduce manual lead-cleanup work and keep CRM records up to date.

items.title: mectrics
items.description: Your Mac's vitals in the menu bar. Free and open source.
items.summary_zh: mectrics 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏应用，可以把 Mac 的系统运行状态直接显示在菜单栏里。对想快速查看机器状态的开发者来说很实用；因为是开源软件，代码透明度高，也方便自行修改或审查。
items.summary_en: mectrics is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that puts your Mac's vitals directly in the menu bar. It's a practical choice for developers who want quick system monitoring without paying or trusting closed-source tools, and having the source code available makes it easy to audit or extend.

items.title: Poth Labs
items.description: The customer brain for your company
items.summary_zh: Poth Labs 在 Product Hunt 上发布，其简介自称是“公司的客户大脑”。从这一描述推断，它可能面向客户数据整合与洞察场景，但具体功能、集成方式、定价等尚未在简介中列出，需要前往产品页确认。
items.summary_en: Poth Labs launched on Product Hunt, described simply as “the customer brain for your company.” That tagline points to customer-data aggregation or insight, but the listing doesn't include details on features, integrations, or pricing, so the exact scope isn't clear from the description.

items.title: SKI
items.description: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
items.summary_zh: SKI是一款免费语音编程工具，支持Claude Code、Codex等主流AI编程助手，让开发者直接用自然语言口述代码指令，无需动手输入。它解决了程序员因键盘操作导致的肢体疲劳问题，同时也为行动不便的群体提供了更友好的编程方式。最吸引人的是它完全免费，降低了尝试门槛，是追求高效无障碍编程体验者的实用选择。
items.summary_en: SKI is a free voice coding tool that works with popular AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex, letting developers dictate commands and code instructions naturally instead of typing. It addresses common issues like repetitive strain injuries and accessibility barriers, making programming more inclusive and comfortable. The fact that it's free lowers the entry barrier significantly, so anyone curious about hands-free development can simply plug it in and start speaking. For developers with physical discomfort or those just wanting a more ergonomic workflow, SKI offers a practical and approachable solution.

items.title: Memmy Agent
items.description: Let every AI remember the same you.
items.summary_zh: Memmy Agent致力于解决AI记忆碎片化的问题，它创建一个统一的用户记忆层，让不同的AI助手和工具都能记住同一个你。无论你使用ChatGPT、Claude还是其他AI产品，你的偏好、背景信息和上下文都能被共享，从而获得高度个性化的连贯体验。对于重度AI用户和追求跨平台一致性的专业人士来说，这款工具能极大提升效率，减少重复介绍和重新设置带来的麻烦。
items.summary_en: Memmy Agent builds a unified memory layer that lets every AI tool remember the same version of you. Instead of each chatbot or assistant starting from scratch, your preferences, background details, and context are shared across platforms, so the experience feels continuous and genuinely personal. This solves a common frustration for heavy AI users who constantly have to repeat themselves or lose important context when switching tools. Professionals who juggle multiple AI assistants in daily workflows will benefit the most, as Memmy reduces redundancy and makes every interaction more informed and tailored. It's an elegant step toward making AI truly understand you, not just handle isolated requests.

items.title: AI Search Console
items.description: Prompt analytics and citation mapping for AI search
items.summary_zh: AI Search Console是一款专门为AI搜索时代打造的提示词分析和引用映射工具。它能帮助品牌和内容创作者追踪自己的内容在ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索引擎中被引用的情况，查看哪些提示词触发了品牌提及，以及竞争对手的可见度如何。对于SEO专业人员、内容营销人员和关注品牌在线影响力的人来说，这是一款极具针对性的数据洞察平台。
items.summary_en: AI Search Console provides prompt analytics and citation mapping for the fast-growing world of AI-powered search. It lets brands and content creators see exactly how their material gets referenced inside AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Perplexity, which prompts trigger brand appearances, and how they compare to competitors. This addresses the emerging challenge of tracking visibility in answer engines rather than traditional Google results. For SEO professionals, content marketers, and brand managers who want to understand their footprint in the AI search landscape, this tool offers essential clarity and actionable data in one focused dashboard.

items.title: Claude Code usage tracking by LangWatch
items.description: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
items.summary_zh: LangWatch 新推出的工具专门为 Claude Code 会话提供成本追踪服务，让开发者清楚知道每次编码会话实际花了多少钱。它能拆解 API 调用、token 消耗和耗时，帮助个人开发者或团队更好地控制 AI 编程预算，优化使用效率。对于重度依赖 Claude Code 的用户来说，这是一款非常实用的成本管理利器。
items.summary_en: LangWatch has launched a new tool that tracks the real cost of your Claude Code sessions, breaking down API calls, token usage, and time spent. It helps developers and teams understand exactly what they're spending on AI coding, so they can manage budgets and optimize usage more effectively. For anyone relying heavily on Claude Code, this is a handy cost-control layer that turns vague anxiety about bills into clear, actionable data.

items.title: NINA
items.description: Guide users step by step inside your product.
items.summary_zh: NINA 是一个产品内引导工具，用于在应用界面中制作分步式新手教程和操作提示。它支持通过可视化配置快速上线引导流程，帮助新用户理解核心功能，适合产品团队优化激活与留存。
items.summary_en: NINA is an in-app guidance tool for building step-by-step onboarding tours and interactive tips directly inside your product. It offers a visual configuration workflow so product managers can launch guides without heavy code changes, helping improve activation and user retention.

items.title: Prelint
items.description: Prevent product drift in AI-written code
items.summary_zh: Prelint是一款专门防止AI生成代码出现“产品漂移”的检查工具。当AI编写的代码虽然语法正确却偏离了业务需求时，Prelint能通过自定义规则和语义分析提前拦截这类问题。它特别适合在使用Copilot、Codex等AI编码助手的团队中充当质检关口，确保生成的代码不仅跑得通，还能真正满足产品需求。对于想放心利用AI提速又不想牺牲产品质量的开发者来说，Prelint是缺不了的安全网。
items.summary_en: Prelint is a linter purpose‑built for AI‑generated code, tackling the growing problem of product drift—where code compiles and runs but subtly strays from business requirements. It uses custom rules and semantic analysis to catch these mismatches before they hit production. For teams relying on AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex, Prelint acts as a quality gate, ensuring the output aligns with actual product intent. Developers who want to accelerate with AI without sacrificing accuracy will find it an indispensable safety net. It bridges the gap between fast code generation and reliable software delivery.

items.title: SoundGate Guitar
items.description: AI Music Tutor that gives real-time feedback on your playing
items.summary_zh: SoundGate Guitar是一款AI音乐导师，它能够在用户弹奏吉他时实时分析音准、节奏和技巧，并给出精准的纠正建议。对于初学者来说，这相当于拥有了一个24小时在线的私人教练，无需再依赖昂贵的线下课程。而进阶玩家也能通过它发现细微的演奏瑕疵，提升表现力。这款工具巧妙地将人工智能与音乐教育结合，解决了传统自学缺乏即时反馈的痛点，让练琴变得高效又有趣。
items.summary_en: SoundGate Guitar is an AI music tutor that provides real-time feedback on your guitar playing. It analyzes pitch, rhythm, and technique as you play, offering instant corrections and suggestions. For beginners, this eliminates the need for expensive in-person lessons, giving them a personal coach available around the clock. Advanced players can use it to refine subtle imperfections and improve expressiveness. By combining artificial intelligence with music education, SoundGate solves the core problem of self-learning—the lack of immediate feedback—making practice sessions both effective and engaging.

items.title: Denovo
items.description: Turn your vibe-coded app into paying customers
items.summary_zh: Denovo是一款帮助开发者把vibe coding快速搭建出的应用转化为实际收入的工具。很多用自然语言生成的代码原型往往停留在demo阶段，Denovo提供支付、订阅、用户管理等商业化功能集成，让这些应用能够轻松实现收费闭环。对于独立开发者、创业团队以及AI产品爱好者来说，这是连接创意原型与可持续商业模式的桥梁，能显著加速产品变现过程并验证市场价值。
items.summary_en: Denovo helps developers turn vibe-coded apps—those quickly built with natural language prompts—into actual sources of revenue. While many such prototypes never leave the demo stage, Denovo provides easy integration for payments, subscriptions, user management, and other monetization essentials, completing the leap from fun experiment to viable business. It's designed for indie hackers, startup founders, and AI enthusiasts who want to validate their ideas without wrestling with complex billing infrastructure. By removing the friction around getting paid, Denovo lets builders focus on what they care about: making a product people love. This is a legitimate bridge between rapid AI-assisted creation and sustainable commercial success.

items.title: /mission for Claude Code
items.description: Give Claude Code missions to spawn a team of agents
items.summary_zh: /mission 为 Claude Code 增加了一条斜杠命令，允许用户定义一项“使命”并自动派生出多个子代理并行处理代码任务。它适用于大型代码库的重构、跨文件修改和多模块测试，让 Claude Code 从单线程问答变成可编排的多代理协作。
items.summary_en: /mission is a slash command for Claude Code that lets you set a mission and automatically spawn a team of sub-agents to work in parallel. It's designed for large-scale refactoring, cross-file edits, or multi-module testing, scaling Claude Code from one-off chatbot responses to coordinated agent workflows.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: Kimi K3太牛了！但老板说API太贵，让我本地化部署，我算完成本，他涨红脸沉默不语了！其实成本不高，三千万足矣。
items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 小米MiMoCode官网颜值高？Codex：拿来吧，您嘞！1:1完美复刻～
items.description: 看到小米MiMo Code官网那个鼠标擦除露图的动效，直接没忍住。把链接丢给Codex，这个AI Coding Agent十分钟就帮我1:1复刻了整站，连字体和DESIGN.md设计规范都扒下来了。A
items.summary_zh: 开发者把小米 MiMo Code 官网链接丢给 Codex，十分钟就 1:1 复刻整站，连鼠标擦除露图动效、字体和 DESIGN.md 设计规范都一并还原。这个例子直观展示了 AI 编程代理处理前端交互和设计细节的能力，关注 AI 辅助编程的开发者可以看看。
items.summary_en: A developer handed the Xiaomi MiMo Code site URL to Codex and got a 1:1 clone in ten minutes, including the mouse-erase reveal effect, fonts, and the DESIGN.md spec. It shows how AI coding agents can reproduce front-end interactions and design details, relevant if you're evaluating AI-assisted development.

items.title: 携程员工：在携程4年，月薪3万左右，基本没涨薪了。不过挺满足的，毕竟稳定，福利也不错（附Agent面试题）
items.description: 携程员工爆料4年月薪3万没涨薪但满足，14道Coding Agent面试题全解：Prompt组装、上下文三层压缩、Tool与Skill区别、多Agent编排、Plan设计，附源码级回答。
items.summary_zh: 一位携程员工透露自己在公司四年月薪约三万元且几乎没涨过，但他表示挺满足，因为工作稳定、福利不错。文章还附带了14道 Coding Agent 面试题的源码级解析，涵盖 Prompt 组装、上下文三层压缩、Tool 与 Skill 区别、多 Agent 编排、Plan 设计等，对准备 AI 智能体相关岗位的开发者很有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A Ctrip employee shared that after four years at the company, his salary is still around 30,000 yuan a month with almost no raises, yet he feels satisfied because the job is stable and benefits are good. The post also includes detailed source-level answers to 14 Coding Agent interview questions, covering prompt assembly, three-layer context compression, the difference between tools and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and plan design. Developers prepping for AI agent roles will find this a valuable reference.

items.title: 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
items.description: 真实的 AI 开发微信小游戏全流程记录：技术栈、prompt、踩坑清单、成本明细全公开。文末有彩蛋。
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章完整记录了一位开发者利用AI辅助技术从零构建并上线微信小游戏的全过程。作者毫无保留地公开了技术栈、提示词（prompt）设计、遇到的各类踩坑问题以及详细的成本明细，甚至附有彩蛋。对于想尝试用AI加速小游戏开发但又缺乏经验的团队或个人来说，这篇实战复盘提供了真实可参考的路线图和避坑指南，展现了AI在降低开发门槛方面的巨大潜力。
items.summary_en: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of building and launching a WeChat mini game entirely with AI assistance. The author shares everything from the technology stack and prompt engineering techniques to a detailed breakdown of costs and a list of common pitfalls encountered during the process, ending with a hidden bonus. For indie developers or small teams curious about leveraging AI to speed up game development, this real-world case study serves as an invaluable reference. It demonstrates how AI tools can dramatically lower the barrier to entry for game creation, making it accessible even to those without a deep coding background.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: Meta 提出算力过剩观点后 AI 股市应声下跌，引发行业焦虑。文章反思 AI 应用三年未爆发的原因：基础设施投入巨大但 killer app 缺失，用户对 ChatGPT 等工具的新鲜感消退，而企业级落地面临成本和安全挑战。作者认为 AI 不会重蹈互联网泡沫，但需要找到像抖音微信那样的超级场景才能引爆下一波增长。
items.summary_en: When Meta suggested there was too much computing capacity, AI stocks tumbled, revealing deep anxiety in the industry. This article reflects on why AI applications haven't exploded after three years: massive infrastructure spending without a killer app, declining novelty of chatbots like ChatGPT, and enterprise deployment hurdles around cost and security. The author argues it's not a repeat of the 2000 dot-com bubble, but AI needs its own TikTok or WeChat moment to trigger the next growth wave. It's a sobering reality check for the industry.

items.title: 白嫖DeepSeek V4 Pro！免费无限用，还能接入Claude-Code
items.description: 先放个结论：按星哥的步骤配置完，你就能在本地工具里直接调用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的免费额度，不用充值，不用复杂操作，5 步就能搞定！ 免费的模型： 一、准备工作 想薅这个羊毛，提前准备好这
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了如何通过简单五步配置，在本地开发工具中免费无限使用DeepSeek V4 Pro模型，无需充值即可调用其强大能力，甚至还能接入Claude-Code。作者提供了详细的准备工作与操作指南，手把手教用户“薅羊毛”。对于AI开发者和爱好者而言，这是一份极具价值的省钱攻略，能让他们在不花费任何成本的情况下使用顶级AI模型加速编程和创作。
items.summary_en: This tutorial explains how to configure local development tools to use the DeepSeek V4 Pro model for free and unlimited access with just five simple steps, and also covers integrating Claude-Code. The guide, written by a blogger known as 'Xing Ge', provides detailed instructions to help developers and AI enthusiasts leverage top-tier AI models without spending a dime. It is a valuable resource for programmers and creators looking to accelerate their workflows using cutting-edge AI at zero cost.

items.title: 2026 了，前端转 AI 全栈我是这么学的 😍😍😍
items.description: 最近，"前端已死，全栈永生" 又开始在技术圈流行。 支付宝体验技术部已经解散并完成拆分，原有人员分流到各条业务线。这件事传开以后，很多人又往下推一步，变成 "前端作为独立工种肯定会消失"。 更准确的事
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章从支付宝体验技术部解散说起，讨论“前端已死”背后的真实趋势，并给出前端转 AI 全栈的学习路线。作者认为前端作为独立工种不会消失，但技能栈需要重构，还分享了具体的项目实践建议。适合因为裁员焦虑的前端开发者读一读。
items.summary_en: This article uses the disbanding of Alipay's Experience Technology Department to analyze the real trend behind the 'frontend is dead' claim, then maps out a learning path from frontend to AI full-stack development. The author argues that frontend as a separate job won't vanish but its skill stack must be rebuilt, and offers concrete project suggestions. It's a useful read for frontend developers anxious about layoffs.

items.title: 程序员副业 | 2026年4月复盘
items.description: 我看后台有人催更，确实很久没写复盘了，年后一直在折腾，今天有时间，来复盘下4月份做的事情吧，最近真的是疯狂在通宵编程哈哈，今天我开发的软件发布了新版本，稍微可以清闲一下。
items.summary_zh: 这是一位程序员分享的2026年4月副业复盘，作者回应读者催更，讲述了自己年后持续折腾、通宵编程开发软件并发布新版本的经历。文章展现了副业程序员面临的巨大时间投入与自我驱动力，同时也描述了新版本上线后的短暂轻松。对于同样在探索副业的开发者来说，这篇复盘既是一种共鸣，也是激励——持续投入终会带来可见的成果。
items.summary_en: A programmer shares their side project recap for April 2026, responding to readers who urged an update. The author describes an intense period of coding overnight after the new year, finally releasing a new version of their software. This post highlights the significant time commitment and self-discipline required for side projects, along with the fleeting relief of shipping a release. For developers juggling side hustles, this recap resonates deeply—it shows that sustained effort eventually pays off with tangible progress and a momentary break.

items.description: 当工程、产品、设计在 AI 面前熔合成一种新角色，团队里真正存在的是什么角色？ Claude Code 之父 Boris Cherny 给出一种答案

items.title: 别再裸用 Claude Code 了！32 个亲测Skills + 8 个 MCP，开发效率直接拉满！
items.description: 别再裸用 Claude Code 了！32 个亲测技能 + 8 个 MCP 服务器，开发效率直接拉满！ 先晒一下我装完的效果（见下图），所有技能均实测可用。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者亲测了32个Claude Code实用技能和8个MCP服务器，整理出一套完整的效率提升方案。这些技能覆盖代码补全、重构、调试等关键环节，配合MCP服务器实现任务自动化，让AI编程助手从玩具变成真正的生产力工具。文章强调所有技能均已真实可用，不是理论堆砌，适合所有使用Claude Code的开发者直接上手。
items.summary_en: A developer tested 32 practical Claude Code skills and 8 MCP servers, compiling a comprehensive guide to boost coding efficiency. These skills cover code completion, refactoring, and debugging, while the MCP servers automate repetitive tasks, transforming Claude Code from a gimmick into a real productivity tool. The author emphasizes that all tips have been verified in practice, making this resource valuable for any developer looking to get the most out of their AI coding assistant.

items.title: 普通程序员有没有必要学习 Agent 开发？
items.description: 大家好，我是双越。wangEditor 作者，前百度 滴滴 资深前端工程师，慕课网金牌讲师，PMP，前端面试派作者。本文讨论普通程序员要不要学习 AI Agent 开发。
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章由资深前端工程师双越撰写，探讨普通程序员是否需要学习AI Agent开发。作者结合自身经验，分析了Agent开发对程序员职业发展的潜在影响，认为虽然并非所有人必须立刻投身其中，但了解这一趋势有助于在AI浪潮中保持竞争力。文章引发了对技术路线选择的深度思考。
items.summary_en: In this article, senior front-end engineer Shuangyue discusses whether ordinary programmers should learn AI Agent development. Drawing from his own experience, he analyzes the potential impact on career growth, arguing that while not everyone needs to dive in immediately, understanding this trend helps stay competitive in the AI wave. The piece sparks deep reflection on technology path choices.

items.title: 如何设计一个优秀的 Skills
items.description: 大家好，我是石小石~ 引言：AI 的下一阶段，不只是更会思考 最近，被一个新概念深深吸引了： "具身交互智能" 。 它的核心主张很直白：让 AI 拥有身体、感知世界、理解环境，并通过语音、表情、动作和
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了如何设计一个优秀的AI技能系统，重点介绍了“具身交互智能”这一前沿概念，即让AI拥有身体并能感知世界、理解环境、通过语音表情动作与人自然互动。这一设计理念将推动AI从纯语言模型向多模态、有实体的智能体进化，解决AI在物理世界中行动和感知的难题，对开发者设计下一代人机交互产品具有重要启发意义。
items.summary_en: This article explores how to design an excellent AI skills system, focusing on the cutting-edge concept of 'embodied interactive intelligence.' It argues that the next phase of AI goes beyond reasoning—AI should have a body, perceive the world, understand environments, and interact through voice, expressions, and gestures. This approach solves the problem of AI operating in physical spaces, enabling more natural human-machine collaboration. Developers building the next generation of smart assistants, robots, or metaverse avatars will find these design principles transformative.

items.title: 全网都在吹的 Kimi K3，到底怎么样？
items.description: 国产最贵、速度还慢，凭什么还是国产之光？Kimi K3 前端能力全球第一梯队，长任务处理稳，还是开源模型，这次是真敢跟顶尖闭源模型掰手腕了。
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3 虽然价格昂贵、速度偏慢，却凭借其全球第一梯队的前端（视觉）能力和稳定的长任务处理表现，被称为国产之光。它还是开源模型，敢于与顶尖闭源模型竞争，尤其在代码和视觉相关的任务上展现强大实力。对于追求开源和高质量视觉理解的开发者来说，Kimi K3 是一个值得关注的选项。
items.summary_en: Kimi K3, despite being expensive and relatively slow, has earned the reputation as a light of domestic AI thanks to its top-tier front-end visual capabilities and stable long-task processing. It is open-source and dares to compete with leading closed-source models. Particularly strong in code-related and visual understanding tasks, Kimi K3 offers a compelling option for developers who value transparency and want to push boundaries in multimodal AI.

items.title: Kimi k3是真碉，但太不经用，也有拉跨点！
items.description: K3 已测，确实强，但要命的是配额太少了！ 一天不到，一周的配额已经烧完了，大概就生成了 5 个测试页面！ 从五个例子中，可以知道，有些确实很强，有些呢又差点意思，有些比较糟糕。 我不是那种收钱办事儿
items.summary_zh: Kimi 的 K3 模型实测表现确实强悍，但致命缺陷是配额太少，一周的额度在一天内就用完了，只生成了五个测试页面。从这几个例子看，有的生成效果很棒，有的却不尽如人意，甚至有些糟糕。作者强调自己并非收钱办事，而是真实体验，这让 K3 的实际可用性打了折扣。
items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.title: 我把刘备一生做成了可播放的高德地图，还把整套方法封装成了 Skill
items.description: 人生很短，不过三万天。人生经纬，高德陪你看看你的过去的人生。 你可以用人生经纬Skill来了解的某个人物（偶像，名人）的一生，看看他的一生是什么样的，你也可以看看自己的一生
items.summary_zh: 作者将刘备一生做成可播放的高德地图，并把整套方法封装成名为“人生经纬”的 Skill。该 Skill 可用来查看偶像、名人甚至自己的一生轨迹，按时间与地点把人生“播放”出来。适合对 AI 叙事、地理可视化或个人传记感兴趣的人参考。
items.summary_en: The author turned Liu Bei's life into a playable Amap (Gaode Maps) route and packaged the whole method as a Skill called "人生经纬." With it, users can view the life trajectories of idols, celebrities, or themselves, replaying a life through time and locations. It's a good reference for anyone interested in AI storytelling or geographic visualization.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.

items.title: 为什么 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练如此有效？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练效果好，关键在于把预算集中在强化学习而非简单微调：团队用大规模合成数据构建指令集，配合多目标奖励模型做迭代。相比传统 SFT，这种"小模型筛选、大模型生成"的管线大幅提升了样本利用率和推理表现。对开源社区来说，这套后训练方案比模型权重本身更有工程参考价值。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731's post-training works well because the team shifted most of the budget to reinforcement learning rather than plain fine-tuning: large-scale synthetic instruction data was combined with a multi-objective reward model and iterative rollout. This generation-and-filter pipeline improves sample efficiency and reasoning output compared with standard SFT. For the open-source community, the post-training recipe may be more valuable than the released weights.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 flash 上线，相较 Kimi K3 各有哪些优劣？现版本大模型中你的选择是啥？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 正式上线，主打低延迟和更低推理成本，官方在部分评测中与 Kimi K3 对标；Kimi K3 则在长上下文理解和复杂推理上保持优势。Flash 适合高频交互、对预算敏感的应用，K3 更适合深度分析和多步骤任务。开发者选型时需结合 context 长度、价格和真实业务场景，不宜只看跑分。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash has launched with a focus on low latency and reduced inference costs; official benchmarks put it near Kimi K3, while K3 retains an edge in long-context comprehension and complex reasoning. Flash suits high-frequency, cost-sensitive applications, whereas K3 fits deep-analysis or multi-step workflows. Developers should evaluate context windows, pricing, and their actual workload rather than relying solely on leaderboards.

items.title: 如何看待 OpenAI 下一代模型 Astra 大量解决数学猜想？
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 以Astra为代号的新模型声称在多个数学猜想上取得验证进展，但目前只有口头报告，没有论文或详细结果。若实现，将把大模型从计算工具推向自动推理和形式化证明领域。适合AI研究和机器学习工程师关注其后续可复现性。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's next-generation model, codenamed Astra, is reported to have made significant progress on several mathematical conjectures, but no paper or reproducible details have surfaced yet. If confirmed, it could push large language models into automated reasoning and formal proof. AI researchers should watch for follow-up evidence.

items.title: 字节系在移动互联网用户时长的占比升至  40.1%，正式超越腾讯系的 29.7%，你怎么看？
items.summary_zh: 据QuestMobile数据，字节系移动互联网用户时长占比升至40.1%，腾讯系降至29.7%，用户时长进一步向抖音等短视频产品集中。推荐算法与信息流形态是字节增长的核心，而腾讯攻防更多依赖微信生态内视频号。关注流量格局变化的开发者，可借此思考内容平台的分发逻辑。
items.summary_en: ByteDance's share of China's mobile internet user time reached 40.1%, surpassing Tencent's 29.7% for the first time, according to QuestMobile. The growth is driven by short-video apps and recommendation feeds, while Tencent relies on WeChat's video channels. This trend offers developers insight into content distribution and platform competition.

items.title: 最近内存、存储甚至显卡涨价，一个个都说自己要当等等党，等到 2040 年能成功吗？
items.summary_zh: 内存、存储和显卡涨价主因是AI服务器需求挤占产能、原厂调整产出，短期供需错配难以缓解。所谓的“等等党”面对的是长期价格上行，2040年显然只是调侃。对DIY和云计算成本敏感者，建议关注HBM产能与先进制程的节奏。
items.summary_en: RAM, storage, and GPU prices are rising due to AI server demand and factory capacity allocation, creating a supply-demand gap unlikely to ease soon. Waiting until 2040 for a drop is just a meme. DIY builders and cloud users should instead track HBM capacity and advanced-node availability.

items.title: 都说 KMP 算法效率高，现实中真没看到哪些领域用到的最多？
items.summary_zh: KMP算法现实中最常用于文本编辑器的查找、正则引擎、搜索引擎分词和基因序列比对等需要高效子串搜索的场景，但多数时候以封装库出现。它的核心价值在于前缀函数思想，常被内置在底层工具链中。处理超大规模文本或字符串匹配的开发者，学习KMP仍有助于理解性能优化。
items.summary_en: KMP is widely embedded in text editors, regex engines, search indexing, and bioinformatics for substring matching, though rarely written by hand. Its prefix-function idea shapes many low-level tools. Developers working on large-scale text processing can still benefit from understanding KMP for performance tuning.

items.title: 三大运营商停止第三方互联网渠道号卡办理，低价大流量卡将集体退场，出于哪些考量？对普通消费者有什么影响？
items.summary_zh: 三大运营商全面关闭第三方互联网渠道的号卡办理，直播带货、电商平台上的低价套餐代办将集体消失。收紧的目的是清理行业乱象、强化实名制和反诈管控，同时也为运营商让利促销降温。普通用户后续大概率只能从官方 App 或营业厅办理，低月租大流量卡更难买到。
items.summary_en: China's three major telecom operators have shut down third-party internet channels for new SIM card registrations, eliminating cheap high-data plans sold through live streams and e-commerce platforms. The move targets irregular sales, tighter real-name rules, and anti-fraud enforcement, while easing price competition. Regular users will have to rely on official apps or brick-and-mortar stores, where low-cost high-volume plans will be harder to get.

items.title: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日起施行，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日施行，全面替代旧版出入境法规，涉及护照、通行证签发、口岸查验及外国人停留居留规则。新规对证件办理时限作出明确要求，并统一各口岸流程。近期有出境计划、留学或涉外工作安排的人应尽快对照更新后的规定检查证件和签证。
items.summary_en: The State Council's new Regulation on Exit and Entry Administration takes effect on September 15, replacing older rules that governed passports, travel permits, border checks, and foreigners' stay and residence. It sets explicit deadlines for travel document issuance and standardizes procedures across ports. Anyone planning trips abroad, studying, or working overseas should review the updated rules well ahead of time.

items.title: 自己暂时没有开车需求，却不断被父母催着考驾照，有必要为了「以后总会用到」现在就学吗？
items.summary_zh: 知乎热帖讨论暂无用车需求却被迫考驾照的悖论。高赞回答从时间成本和驾考政策角度算账，认为若用不上就不必为‘以后总会用到’付费；也有人指出驾照在升学、应急时仍是刚需。适合被父母催考的年轻人参考。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu thread explores whether to learn driving now even when you don't need it, just because parents push it. Top answers weigh the time and money spent against a future that may never come; the consensus is to wait until you actually need a license. Others point out practical cases like school or emergencies. Helpful for anyone facing family pressure.

items.title: 少投入不是苹果的免死金牌

The announcement signals that the AI hardware battle has moved beyond raw compute into holistic infrastructure efficiency.

This matters for the chemical industry, which has traditionally been slow to digitize. Manufacturers adopting these approaches can expect faster time-to-market, improved product quality, and more efficient production operations. It's a concrete example of how AI is moving beyond software into physical-world industrial applications.

items.title: GitHub AI Agent 翻车：攻击者不用黑客技术，只写一句话就能窃取数据
items.summary_zh: 这次GitHub AI Agent的安全事故令人警醒：攻击者完全不需要利用复杂黑客技术，只需在指令中写下一句恶意提示，就能诱导AI Agent泄露敏感数据。文章深入剖析了攻击原理，指出AI Agent在遵循用户指令时缺乏安全边界，因而被提示注入攻击轻松得逞。这提醒开发者在接入AI Agent时，必须重视输入过滤和权限隔离，避免过度信任，对使用GitHub Copilot等服务的开发者尤其重要。
items.summary_en: A recent security incident involving GitHub's AI agent shows that attackers can steal sensitive data without any hacking skills—simply by embedding a malicious sentence in instructions. The article analyzes how prompt injection tricks the agent into bypassing its intended boundaries, revealing a fundamental lack of safety constraints in current AI agent design. It urges developers to implement strict input validation and permission isolation when integrating AI agents, rather than blindly trusting outputs. This is particularly critical for teams using GitHub Copilot or similar tools in their workflows.

items.summary_zh: 用户在帖中对比两大搜索引擎对 DMCA 删除请求的响应差异，称 Google 在版权投诉处理上更严格，删除结果更快更全面，而 Bing 则相对宽松。这会影响站长和内容创作者对搜索流量的预期，尤其是涉及版权争议内容时。评论中有人指出 Google 的自动化系统也可能误删，需注意申诉渠道。
items.summary_en: A user reports that Google handles DMCA takedown requests more strictly than Bing, with faster and more comprehensive removal of search results. This matters for webmasters and creators who rely on search traffic, particularly for copyright-sensitive material. Some commenters note Google's automated system may over-remove, so filing counter-notices is essential.

items.title: [推广] 直供 Claude 等海外模型官网 key ，有需求的企业大厂来看看
items.summary_zh: V2EX 上一则推广帖称可直供 Claude 等海外模型的官网 API key，客户群体以企业和大型厂商为主。帖子强调“直供”和“官网”，并声称有需求的企业“大厂”可联系。对需要合规获取海外模型 API 的团队或许有用，但需自行核实渠道资质，避免充值风险。
items.summary_en: A promotional post on V2EX offers direct sourcing of official API keys for Claude and other overseas models, targeting enterprises and large companies. It stresses the 'official' channel and invites corporate buyers to get in touch. Teams should verify the vendor's credentials before committing, given potential payment and compliance risks.

items.title: [问与答] ssh 管理工具求教
items.summary_zh: 发帖者向社区询问 SSH 连接管理方案，期望替代自带终端或简化多主机管理。回帖中推荐了 Termius、FinalShell、Tabby 等跨平台工具，还有人建议用 Shell 脚本配合 ssh config 自定义。适合运维和经常需要连接多台服务器的开发者，选择时可以考虑是否支持密钥管理、同步和团队协作。
items.summary_en: The poster asks for SSH client management tools, hoping to simplify working with multiple hosts. Commenters recommend cross-platform apps like Termius, FinalShell, and Tabby, while others suggest scripting with ssh config. Useful for DevOps engineers and developers who frequently manage servers — consider features like keychain storage, cloud sync, and team collaboration when choosing.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了个会把清单藏起来的 todo app
items.summary_zh: 一款另类的 todo 应用，采用「先藏后看」的交互：清单默认收起来，需要时手动展开，从而让用户聚焦单条任务。对于待办列表很长又容易焦虑的人来说，这种设计能显著降低压力。
items.summary_en: A newly shared todo app flips the usual list design: the entire list stays hidden until the user deliberately expands it, letting them focus on a single task. The author built it as a way to reduce visual clutter and anxiety, and it may appeal to people who feel overwhelmed by long to-do lists.

items.title: [分享发现] 8 月份网易云音乐黑胶会员领取，天数随机
items.summary_zh: 网易云音乐8月有一个黑胶会员领取活动正在进行，用户可以获得随机天数的VIP，具体时长因人而异。该活动由V2EX用户先行发现，帖子中提供了参与方式，感兴趣的话可以按提示去App里找入口。
items.summary_en: A NetEase Cloud Music promotion for August lets users claim a black-vinyl VIP membership for free, with the number of days randomly assigned per account. The offer was first shared by a V2EX user, who also pointed to the in-app entry point. Since the campaign is clearly time-limited, anyone interested should act quickly before it disappears.

items.title: [分享发现] 今天怎么回事？ x 都在发收益？
items.summary_zh: 帖主观察到当天社交平台 X 上大量用户晒收益截图，似乎与某个活动或空投相关。评论中有人推测是加密货币激励或广告分成计划，也有网友表示只是集中炫耀。这条动态反映 X 平台近期在创作者变现上的新动作，适合关注社交平台生态变化的从业者留意。
items.summary_en: The author notices an unusual wave of users on X posting earnings screenshots, possibly tied to a promotion or crypto airdrop. Commenters speculate about an incentive scheme or ad revenue program, while others see it as mere flexing. The thread highlights X’s recent shifts in creator monetization, relevant for those tracking social platform dynamics.

items.title: [Wunder] V2EX AI Chat 可用模型列表新增 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 版本
items.summary_zh: V2EX 的 AI Chat 功能在可用模型中加入了 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731，这是 DeepSeek 系列里的 Flash 变体，定位是更快的响应速度。该版本带有 0731 日期标记，可能针对某些任务做了优化，适合在聊天里快速测试或日常使用。
items.summary_en: V2EX's AI Chat now includes DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 in its list of available models. As a Flash variant, it's designed for faster responses, and the 0731 date tag likely points to a newer snapshot. Users who want low-latency chat can try it from the model picker, making it a good fit for quick tasks or everyday questions.

items.title: [汽车] 问一下大家： NOA/辅助驾驶 之类的，使用频率高吗？
items.summary_zh: V2EX 汽车版块有车友发帖调查 NOA/辅助驾驶的真实使用频率，征集车主在通勤和长途场景下的开启习惯。这类讨论能反映智能辅助驾驶从尝鲜到日常依赖的渗透程度，对考虑选装智驾功能的潜在车主有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user in the car section asks how often drivers actually use NOA or other assisted-driving features in daily life. The thread collects real-world usage frequency on commutes and long trips. It offers a pragmatic snapshot of whether smart-driving features become habitual or stay as novelties, useful for prospective EV buyers.

items.title: [问与答] 使用 openrouter API 报错
items.summary_zh: 有开发者在 V2EX 求助调用 OpenRouter API 时遇到的报错，并贴出请求参数与错误信息求排查思路。这类问题常见于模型标识不正确、额度不足或响应格式变化，适合遇到类似问题的后端和 LLM 集成开发者对照排查。
items.summary_en: A developer on V2EX asks for help with an OpenRouter API error, providing request details and error output. The discussion serves as a quick troubleshooting reference for common issues like invalid model names, insufficient credits, or changed response schemas. Backend and LLM-integration devs hitting similar errors may find practical clues.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了一个完全在浏览器本地处理的图片拼接工具： MergeImage
items.summary_zh: 作者在 V2EX 分享了自制的纯前端图片拼接工具 MergeImage，所有处理都在浏览器本地完成，无需上传服务器。它主要面向截图拼接、长图合并这类轻量需求，对图片隐私敏感的用户尤其合适。
items.summary_en: MergeImage is a fully client-side image stitching tool; all processing happens in the browser with no file uploads. It supports horizontal/vertical merging and simple ordering, making it handy for privacy-conscious users who need to combine screenshots or long images without third-party servers.

items.title: [分享创造] 3 月份 Vibe Coding 的一个小项目，画布模式的日记小软件，自用，开源
items.summary_zh: 作者在 3 月用 Vibe Coding 做了个画布式日记应用并将它开源，最初定位是自用工具。它把日记条目自由摆放在画布上，而不是按时间线排列，适合喜欢视觉化记录、愿意动手改代码的开发者。
items.summary_en: This is an open-source canvas-style diary app that the author built with Vibe Coding in March as a personal tool. Instead of a chronological feed, it lets you arrange journal entries freely on a canvas. Developers who prefer visual journaling and want to customize their own tools may find it an interesting starting point.
