digest_items.title: 三大运营商停止第三方互联网渠道号卡办理，低价大流量卡将集体退场，出于哪些考量？对普通消费者有什么影响？
digest_items.summary_zh: 三大运营商全面关闭第三方互联网渠道的号卡办理，直播带货、电商平台上的低价套餐代办将集体消失。收紧的目的是清理行业乱象、强化实名制和反诈管控，同时也为运营商让利促销降温。普通用户后续大概率只能从官方 App 或营业厅办理，低月租大流量卡更难买到。
digest_items.summary_en: China's three major telecom operators have shut down third-party internet channels for new SIM card registrations, eliminating cheap high-data plans sold through live streams and e-commerce platforms. The move targets irregular sales, tighter real-name rules, and anti-fraud enforcement, while easing price competition. Regular users will have to rely on official apps or brick-and-mortar stores, where low-cost high-volume plans will be harder to get.

digest_items.title: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日起施行，哪些信息值得关注？
digest_items.summary_zh: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日施行，全面替代旧版出入境法规，涉及护照、通行证签发、口岸查验及外国人停留居留规则。新规对证件办理时限作出明确要求，并统一各口岸流程。近期有出境计划、留学或涉外工作安排的人应尽快对照更新后的规定检查证件和签证。
digest_items.summary_en: The State Council's new Regulation on Exit and Entry Administration takes effect on September 15, replacing older rules that governed passports, travel permits, border checks, and foreigners' stay and residence. It sets explicit deadlines for travel document issuance and standardizes procedures across ports. Anyone planning trips abroad, studying, or working overseas should review the updated rules well ahead of time.

digest_items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
digest_items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
digest_items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.

digest_items.title: 自己暂时没有开车需求，却不断被父母催着考驾照，有必要为了「以后总会用到」现在就学吗？
digest_items.summary_zh: 知乎热帖讨论暂无用车需求却被迫考驾照的悖论。高赞回答从时间成本和驾考政策角度算账，认为若用不上就不必为‘以后总会用到’付费；也有人指出驾照在升学、应急时仍是刚需。适合被父母催考的年轻人参考。
digest_items.summary_en: A Zhihu thread explores whether to learn driving now even when you don't need it, just because parents push it. Top answers weigh the time and money spent against a future that may never come; the consensus is to wait until you actually need a license. Others point out practical cases like school or emergencies. Helpful for anyone facing family pressure.

digest_items.title: 为什么 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练如此有效？
digest_items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练效果好，关键在于把预算集中在强化学习而非简单微调：团队用大规模合成数据构建指令集，配合多目标奖励模型做迭代。相比传统 SFT，这种"小模型筛选、大模型生成"的管线大幅提升了样本利用率和推理表现。对开源社区来说，这套后训练方案比模型权重本身更有工程参考价值。
digest_items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731's post-training works well because the team shifted most of the budget to reinforcement learning rather than plain fine-tuning: large-scale synthetic instruction data was combined with a multi-objective reward model and iterative rollout. This generation-and-filter pipeline improves sample efficiency and reasoning output compared with standard SFT. For the open-source community, the post-training recipe may be more valuable than the released weights.

digest_items.title: DeepSeek V4 flash 上线，相较 Kimi K3 各有哪些优劣？现版本大模型中你的选择是啥？
digest_items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 正式上线，主打低延迟和更低推理成本，官方在部分评测中与 Kimi K3 对标；Kimi K3 则在长上下文理解和复杂推理上保持优势。Flash 适合高频交互、对预算敏感的应用，K3 更适合深度分析和多步骤任务。开发者选型时需结合 context 长度、价格和真实业务场景，不宜只看跑分。
digest_items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash has launched with a focus on low latency and reduced inference costs; official benchmarks put it near Kimi K3, while K3 retains an edge in long-context comprehension and complex reasoning. Flash suits high-frequency, cost-sensitive applications, whereas K3 fits deep-analysis or multi-step workflows. Developers should evaluate context windows, pricing, and their actual workload rather than relying solely on leaderboards.

digest_items.title: 如何看待 OpenAI 下一代模型 Astra 大量解决数学猜想？
digest_items.summary_zh: OpenAI 以Astra为代号的新模型声称在多个数学猜想上取得验证进展，但目前只有口头报告，没有论文或详细结果。若实现，将把大模型从计算工具推向自动推理和形式化证明领域。适合AI研究和机器学习工程师关注其后续可复现性。
digest_items.summary_en: OpenAI's next-generation model, codenamed Astra, is reported to have made significant progress on several mathematical conjectures, but no paper or reproducible details have surfaced yet. If confirmed, it could push large language models into automated reasoning and formal proof. AI researchers should watch for follow-up evidence.

digest_items.title: 字节系在移动互联网用户时长的占比升至  40.1%，正式超越腾讯系的 29.7%，你怎么看？
digest_items.summary_zh: 据QuestMobile数据，字节系移动互联网用户时长占比升至40.1%，腾讯系降至29.7%，用户时长进一步向抖音等短视频产品集中。推荐算法与信息流形态是字节增长的核心，而腾讯攻防更多依赖微信生态内视频号。关注流量格局变化的开发者，可借此思考内容平台的分发逻辑。
digest_items.summary_en: ByteDance's share of China's mobile internet user time reached 40.1%, surpassing Tencent's 29.7% for the first time, according to QuestMobile. The growth is driven by short-video apps and recommendation feeds, while Tencent relies on WeChat's video channels. This trend offers developers insight into content distribution and platform competition.

digest_items.title: 最近内存、存储甚至显卡涨价，一个个都说自己要当等等党，等到 2040 年能成功吗？
digest_items.summary_zh: 内存、存储和显卡涨价主因是AI服务器需求挤占产能、原厂调整产出，短期供需错配难以缓解。所谓的“等等党”面对的是长期价格上行，2040年显然只是调侃。对DIY和云计算成本敏感者，建议关注HBM产能与先进制程的节奏。
digest_items.summary_en: RAM, storage, and GPU prices are rising due to AI server demand and factory capacity allocation, creating a supply-demand gap unlikely to ease soon. Waiting until 2040 for a drop is just a meme. DIY builders and cloud users should instead track HBM capacity and advanced-node availability.

digest_items.title: 都说 KMP 算法效率高，现实中真没看到哪些领域用到的最多？
digest_items.summary_zh: KMP算法现实中最常用于文本编辑器的查找、正则引擎、搜索引擎分词和基因序列比对等需要高效子串搜索的场景，但多数时候以封装库出现。它的核心价值在于前缀函数思想，常被内置在底层工具链中。处理超大规模文本或字符串匹配的开发者，学习KMP仍有助于理解性能优化。
digest_items.summary_en: KMP is widely embedded in text editors, regex engines, search indexing, and bioinformatics for substring matching, though rarely written by hand. Its prefix-function idea shapes many low-level tools. Developers working on large-scale text processing can still benefit from understanding KMP for performance tuning.

digest_items.title: 9点1氪丨马斯克回应特斯拉剥离中国业务；国内航线燃油附加费将再次下调；中国最高薪本科专业易主
digest_items.summary_zh: 这是36氪每日早报，本期选取了马斯克回应特斯拉中国业务传闻、国内航线燃油附加费再次下调，以及本科最高薪专业易主三条要闻。内容覆盖企业战略、交通出行与就业市场，适合想用几分钟快速掌握当天商业动态的读者。
digest_items.summary_en: This is 36Kr’s daily morning briefing, featuring three key stories: Musk’s response to rumors about Tesla splitting off its China business, another cut in domestic flight fuel surcharges, and a change in the highest-paid undergraduate major. It’s a quick read for anyone who wants to stay informed on business news in a few minutes.

digest_items.title: 如何将你对学习的热爱转化为一人公司
digest_items.summary_zh: 文章提出了一套把个人学习热情转化为一人公司业务的可行路径：围绕兴趣持续输出知识，在公开分享中积累信任，再逐步推出课程、咨询等付费产品。适合有持续学习习惯并希望知识变现的独立创作者参考。
digest_items.summary_en: The article lays out a concrete path for turning a love of learning into a solo business: keep sharing what you learn on a specific topic to build trust, then monetize through courses or consulting. It’s aimed at independent creators who want to make money from their self-directed learning.

digest_items.title: 突发，谷歌地球紧急撤回Nano Banana 2生图功能
digest_items.summary_zh: 谷歌地球在Nano Banana 2生图功能上线后出现异常，随即被紧急撤回，官方尚未说明具体原因。此类临时下线通常与内容安全或生成效果有关，使用相关功能的用户和开发者应留意后续公告。
digest_items.summary_en: Google Earth pulled its Nano Banana 2 image-generation feature shortly after launch following unexpected issues, with no official reason given yet. Rollbacks like this are often linked to content safety or output quality, so users and developers should watch for a follow-up explanation.

digest_items.title: 奥特曼承认：高估了AI抢饭碗！黄仁勋：失业论完全搞反了
digest_items.summary_zh: 谈及AI对就业的冲击时，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman坦言外界高估了失业风险，实际影响远小于预期；NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang则反驳“失业论”，认为AI会放大人类能力，反而催生更多职位。两人态度一冷一热，但共同结论是AI在短期内更多是辅助工具。
digest_items.summary_en: Discussing AI's impact on jobs, Sam Altman admitted the threat of mass unemployment is exaggerated, while Jensen Huang dismissed the jobs-apocalypse narrative, arguing AI will amplify human skills and create more roles. Despite their different tones, both imply AI is currently more of an aid than a replacement.

digest_items.title: AI来了，大厂中层不好混了
digest_items.summary_zh: 随着AI接管信息汇总、进度同步等协调工作，科技公司开始压缩中层管理岗位。过去靠“上传下达”立足的管理者成了裁员重灾区，而对一线工程师来说，管理岗减少意味着个人贡献者（IC）路线升值，晋升不再只有“带团队”一条路，技术专家同样能吃香。
digest_items.summary_en: As AI takes over coordination duties like information consolidation and progress tracking, big tech companies are cutting middle-management layers. Managers who relied on relaying messages between teams are now layoff targets. For engineers, this means the individual contributor track gains value — promotion no longer requires managing people, and technical expertise alone can pay off.

digest_items.title: 苹果的5万亿美元时刻：最强财报，最弱AI
digest_items.summary_zh: 苹果发布创纪录假日季财报，营收和利润率双超预期，市值首破5万亿美元。但AI业务仍是短板：Apple Intelligence体验和落地速度落后于微软、谷歌，投资者担心其投入不足。对开发者而言，短期平台AI难有大突破。
digest_items.summary_en: Apple posted record holiday-quarter results, with revenue and margins beating expectations, pushing its market cap above $5 trillion for the first time. However, its AI efforts remain a clear weakness: Apple Intelligence lags rivals like Microsoft and Google in both rollout and usability, and investors are starting to question the company's underwhelming AI investment. Developers should expect limited platform AI capability in the near term.

digest_items.title: 暴增389%，DeepSeek卷到白菜价，这家公司却靠卖Token赚翻了
digest_items.summary_zh: 大模型API价格战白热化，DeepSeek定价已低至“白菜价”，但一家服务商却靠转售Token实现营收暴增389%。其策略是把超低价模型包装成企业级方案，赚取集成与运维费用。对AI应用团队来说，这印证了模型本身正走向零利润，真正的钱在服务层。
digest_items.summary_en: As DeepSeek pushes API prices down to rock-bottom levels, one vendor saw revenue explode 389% by reselling tokens. Instead of competing on model quality, it packages cheap models into enterprise offerings, charging for integration and maintenance. The takeaway: raw model access is commoditized; the money is in the service layer.

digest_items.title: 上海雪花膏，破产了
digest_items.summary_zh: 生产“上海雪花膏”的老字号企业近日宣告破产。这个承载几代人记忆的国货品牌，因产品老化、营销落后，被外资品牌和新型国潮挤出市场。对消费行业而言，这是一个传统品牌转型失败的典型样本。
digest_items.summary_en: The century-old manufacturer behind Shanghai's iconic snow cream jars has filed for bankruptcy. The heritage beauty brand failed to modernize its formulations and marketing, losing ground to foreign brands and new domestic rivals. It's a striking case study in how legacy Chinese consumer brands are being squeezed out of a fast-moving market.

digest_items.title: 少投入不是苹果的免死金牌
digest_items.summary_zh: 评论观点认为，苹果在AI上的“少投入”并不能让它免于竞争压力。尽管服务业务增长强劲，但Apple Intelligence能力不足可能削弱iPhone升级需求，并影响生态黏性。对投资者来说，苹果稳健的基本面无法掩盖其AI差距扩大的长期风险。
digest_items.summary_en: Commentary argues that Apple's deliberately low AI spending won't shield it from competitive pressure. Despite strong services growth, underwhelming Apple Intelligence could dampen iPhone upgrade demand and weaken ecosystem lock-in. It's a reminder that Apple's solid fundamentals don't excuse its growing AI gap — a long-term risk investors should weigh.

digest_items.title: 刚刚，OpenAI全新模型Astra曝光！
digest_items.summary_zh: OpenAI全新模型Astra曝光，据称具备实时语音对话和多模态理解能力，可直接识别视频画面中的物体并同步作答。该模型预计将整合进ChatGPT，被视为对GPT-4o的升级。对AI开发者来说，实时交互应用的构建门槛将因此显著降低。
digest_items.summary_en: OpenAI has revealed Astra, a new model with real-time voice dialogue and multimodal understanding that can identify objects in video and respond on the fly. It's likely to be integrated into ChatGPT in a future release, serving as an upgrade over GPT-4o. For AI developers, this signals that building real-time interactive applications is about to get significantly easier.

digest_items.title: 翁荔被爆重返OpenAI！两天前因身体原因从Thinking Machines Lab离职
digest_items.summary_zh: 曾在 OpenAI 主导安全研究的翁荔被曝将重返 OpenAI，而两天前她才以身体原因从 Thinking Machines Lab 离职。这次回归或与 OpenAI 近期安全团队调整及 Agent 安全研究需求有关，也让外界重新审视 AI 治理的走向。
digest_items.summary_en: Weng Li, a prominent safety researcher who previously led OpenAI's safety work, is reportedly returning to OpenAI just two days after leaving Thinking Machines Lab citing health reasons. The move signals potential shifts in OpenAI's safety team priorities and may interest those tracking AI governance.

digest_items.title: 微软、Meta 同日交财报：小扎把现金流烧到只剩7.84亿美元，纳德拉靠 Azure 赚疯了
digest_items.summary_zh: Meta 最新财报显示自由现金流仅剩 7.84 亿美元，原因是 AI 基础设施投入激增；同日微软发布财报，Azure 云业务增长强劲，纳德拉靠 AI 驱动云业务获得回报。两者对比显示 AI 资本开支已明显影响科技巨头财报，投资者需关注后续投入产出比。
digest_items.summary_en: Meta's latest earnings revealed free cash flow shrank to just $784 million, hit by soaring AI infrastructure spending, while Microsoft posted strong Azure growth the same day. The contrast underscores how AI capex is now reshaping Big Tech financials, a key signal for investors.

digest_items.title: GitHub AI Agent 翻车：攻击者不用黑客技术，只写一句话就能窃取数据
digest_items.summary_zh: 这次GitHub AI Agent的安全事故令人警醒：攻击者完全不需要利用复杂黑客技术，只需在指令中写下一句恶意提示，就能诱导AI Agent泄露敏感数据。文章深入剖析了攻击原理，指出AI Agent在遵循用户指令时缺乏安全边界，因而被提示注入攻击轻松得逞。这提醒开发者在接入AI Agent时，必须重视输入过滤和权限隔离，避免过度信任，对使用GitHub Copilot等服务的开发者尤其重要。
digest_items.summary_en: A recent security incident involving GitHub's AI agent shows that attackers can steal sensitive data without any hacking skills—simply by embedding a malicious sentence in instructions. The article analyzes how prompt injection tricks the agent into bypassing its intended boundaries, revealing a fundamental lack of safety constraints in current AI agent design. It urges developers to implement strict input validation and permission isolation when integrating AI agents, rather than blindly trusting outputs. This is particularly critical for teams using GitHub Copilot or similar tools in their workflows.

digest_items.title: AI浪潮中，如何定义自己的“确定性”之旅？
digest_items.summary_zh: 在AI浪潮席卷各行业之际，如何找到自己的确定性成为普遍焦虑。文章围绕“确定性”这一主题展开，提出面对技术变革，企业和个人都应回归核心能力与长期目标，通过持续学习和迭代构建自身的发展路径。他强调不要被热点裹挟，而要以清晰的价值判断和行动节奏参与AI革命。对于产品经理、技术决策者和创业者来说，这是一篇极富启发性的思考文章。
digest_items.summary_en: As AI transforms every industry, many feel anxious about finding clarity in the chaos. This article explores the concept of "certainty" and suggests that both companies and individuals should anchor on core competencies and long-term goals, rather than chasing every trend. It advocates continuous learning and iteration to carve out a stable development path amid rapid technological change. By focusing on value judgment and consistent action, readers can navigate the AI wave with more confidence. This reflective piece is especially useful for product managers, tech leaders, and startup founders.

digest_items.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin 正式登场：从芯片卷到电网，只为压低每一个 Token 的成本
digest_items.summary_zh: NVIDIA在GTC大会上正式发布Vera Rubin下一代计算平台，不仅升级了芯片性能，更将优化范围扩展到整个电力基础设施。这一代平台强调从芯片到电网的全链路成本优化，目标是把每个Token的生成成本压到最低。对于大规模AI推理和训练用户来说，这意味着更低的运营成本和更高的能效比。
digest_items.summary_en: NVIDIA officially unveiled its Vera Rubin computing platform, marking a strategic shift from chip-level optimization to full-stack infrastructure efficiency. The platform addresses one of AI's most pressing challenges: the soaring cost of powering large-scale inference workloads. By optimizing everything from silicon design to grid-level power distribution, NVIDIA aims to dramatically reduce the per-token cost of AI generation. This matters for enterprises running massive AI deployments, as it directly impacts their operational economics. The announcement signals that the AI hardware battle has moved beyond raw compute into holistic infrastructure efficiency.

digest_items.title: 自构建智能体：一项 LangChain4j 实验
digest_items.summary_zh: 这是LangChain4j框架的一项实验性项目，目标是让AI Agent能够自我构建，即根据任务需求自动生成和组装所需的组件与流程。文章介绍了实验的设计思路、实现原理以及当前的限制，充分展示了Java生态下构建自适应Agent的潜力。虽然仍处于早期阶段，但这一实验为开发者提供了全新思路，让Agent具备更强的自主性和扩展性，特别适合对Agent自动化和Java AI开发感兴趣的工程师关注。
digest_items.summary_en: This article presents an experimental project from LangChain4j that explores self-building agents—agents capable of automatically generating and assembling components for given tasks. The author explains the design rationale, implementation approach, and current limitations, showing how this idea could bring more autonomy and extensibility to AI agents within the Java ecosystem. Though still at an early stage, the experiment offers a novel perspective for developers interested in agent automation and Java-based AI development. It highlights the future potential where agents can adapt themselves to increasingly complex requirements without manual intervention.

digest_items.title: Agent 成本失控背后：上下文、人工审核与维护成本正在被低估｜请回答 WAIC 2026
digest_items.summary_zh: 文章指出 Agent 实际成本常被低估，除了推理调用，大量开销来自上下文窗口消耗、人工审核流程和持续维护。对正在把 Agent 投入生产的团队来说，这类隐性成本可能比模型 API 费用更快吞噬预算，测算 TCO 时需纳入这些项目。
digest_items.summary_en: Agent deployment costs are often underestimated, with significant hidden expenses from context-window usage, human review loops, and ongoing maintenance beyond raw inference calls. Teams moving agents into production should factor these into total cost calculations, as they can outpace API fees.

digest_items.title: 枫清科技高雪峰：AI正在进入材料研发与化工生产全流程
digest_items.summary_zh: 枫清科技高雪峰分享AI在材料研发与化工生产全流程中的落地实践。从分子设计、配方优化到生产过程的智能调控，AI正在重塑传统化工行业的研发范式。这套方案能大幅缩短新材料开发周期，降低实验成本，帮助化工企业提升生产效率和产品质量。对传统制造业数字化转型具有重要参考价值。
digest_items.summary_en: Gao Xuefeng from Fengqing Technology describes how AI is now embedded across the entire materials research and chemical production pipeline. From molecular design and formula optimization to intelligent process control during manufacturing, AI is fundamentally reshaping how chemical companies innovate. The key insight is that AI can dramatically compress the R&D cycle for new materials while reducing expensive experimental trial-and-error costs. This matters for the chemical industry, which has traditionally been slow to digitize. Manufacturers adopting these approaches can expect faster time-to-market, improved product quality, and more efficient production operations. It's a concrete example of how AI is moving beyond software into physical-world industrial applications.

digest_items.title: 从金融专业到资深Builder：我如何借多Agent开发工作流，一周做出MVP、一个月上线
digest_items.summary_zh: 一位金融专业出身的开发者分享转型经验：借助多 Agent 开发工作流，将原本数月的开发周期压缩到一周出 MVP、一个月上线。文章适合非科班出身或小团队开发者，展示了如何拆解任务、让多个 Agent 分工完成需求分析、编码和测试。
digest_items.summary_en: A former finance major turned builder explains how a multi-agent development workflow compressed their build cycle to a one-week MVP and a one-month launch. The piece offers a practical playbook for non-traditional developers and small teams on distributing analysis, coding, and testing across agents.

digest_items.title: Agent 形态一天一个样，Infra 到底该为谁而建？| 请回答 WAIC 2026
digest_items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 Agent 形态快速迭代下，基础设施应围绕开发者、Agent 运行时还是最终用户来建设，指出当前 infra 常追着短期框架跑。对 infra 创业者和平台团队来说，这是投资方向的关键取舍：绑定具体 Agent 架构还是抽象通用层。
digest_items.summary_en: As agent designs shift almost daily, this piece asks whether infrastructure should serve developers, agent runtimes, or end users, arguing that many infra teams chase whichever framework is trendy. For infra founders and platform teams, the question points to a strategic choice between binding to a specific agent architecture or building a generic abstraction layer.

digest_items.title: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
digest_items.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
digest_items.author: zhaoxuya520
digest_items.summary_zh: reverse-skill是一个AI驱动的“技能路由”仓库，面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试和安全研究。它能根据用户请求自动匹配技能、按需搭建工具链，并带有一个自进化的知识库，已支持Claude Code等AI编程环境。适合安全研究者快速实验，但必须确保测试已获合法授权。
digest_items.summary_en: reverse-skill is an AI-powered skill router designed for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research. It matches user requests to the right skills, bootstraps toolchains on demand, and includes a self-evolving knowledge base, with support for Claude Code. It's handy for security researchers to run experiments, but authorized use is a must.

digest_items.title: Elevators
digest_items.author: Jrh0203
digest_items.summary_zh: 这个关于电梯的Hacker News讨论帖引发了广泛关注，话题涵盖电梯调度算法、等待时间优化和现代电梯系统的智能控制技术。电梯作为城市垂直交通的核心设施，其运行效率直接影响着人们的生活和工作体验。讨论中提到的智能电梯系统利用AI进行客流预测和动态调度，能够显著减少等待时间，这一看似平凡的设备背后其实藏着丰富的系统工程和算法设计学问。
digest_items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled "Elevators" has sparked a wide-ranging discussion about the technology behind vertical transportation. The conversation covers elevator dispatch algorithms, wait time optimization, and the emerging role of AI in modern elevator systems. While elevators seem mundane, they represent a fascinating intersection of mechanical engineering, control systems, and operations research. Smart elevator systems now use predictive algorithms and AI to anticipate traffic patterns and dynamically optimize car assignment, significantly reducing wait times in busy buildings. The discussion highlights how an overlooked everyday technology contains deep engineering challenges — from load balancing during rush hour to energy efficiency — making it a compelling topic for engineers and urban technology enthusiasts.

digest_items.title: huggingface/speech-to-speech
digest_items.description: Build local voice agents with open-source models
digest_items.author: huggingface
digest_items.summary_zh: Hugging Face 新开源 speech-to-speech 项目，可在本地构建语音 Agent，无需调用云端 API。它把语音识别、语义理解与语音合成全流程跑在本地硬件上，主打隐私与离线可用。适合想为桌面或智能家居打造私人语音助手的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: Hugging Face has open-sourced speech-to-speech, a toolkit for building voice agents entirely on local hardware. It chains speech recognition, NLU, and synthesis into one pipeline, avoiding cloud APIs and supporting consumer GPUs. A great starting point for developers creating privacy-focused personal voice assistants, and it targets low-latency, offline-first smart home use cases.

digest_items.title: UEFA and its national associations will not participate in FIFA competitions
digest_items.author: dickfickling
digest_items.summary_zh: UEFA及其成员国足协宣布将不参加FIFA旗下赛事，这是国际足球管理体系的重大分裂。起因是全球足球管理机构之间的权力和利益分配矛盾日益激化，特别是关于赛事日程和扩军计划的争议。这一决定可能重塑国际足球赛事的格局，对球员、俱乐部和球迷都将产生深远影响，也可能导致国际足球出现双轨制局面。
digest_items.summary_en: UEFA and its national associations have announced they will boycott FIFA-organized competitions, marking an unprecedented fracture in international football governance. This escalation stems from long-simmering disputes over match scheduling, competition format expansion, and revenue distribution between the two governing bodies. The decision could split the global football landscape into competing jurisdictions, with profound implications for players, clubs, and national teams who may face conflicting commitments. For the sport's fans, it risks creating confusion around international tournaments and disrupting established traditions. This is a power struggle with existential stakes for the world's most popular sport.

digest_items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
digest_items.author: gitpusher42
digest_items.summary_zh: 一个开源项目实现了在2GB内存的M系列Mac上本地运行Gemma 4 26B模型。通过先进的量化技术和内存优化算法，这个引擎大幅降低了运行大语言模型的硬件门槛。普通Mac用户无需昂贵的工作站或云端服务，就能在本地运行强大的AI模型，既保护了数据隐私，又降低了使用成本。对开源AI社区的普及和民主化具有重要意义。
digest_items.summary_en: A new open-source engine enables running Google's Gemma 4 26B model in just 2GB of RAM on any M-series Mac. This is a significant breakthrough for on-device AI, achieved through advanced quantization and aggressive memory optimization techniques. Previously, running a model of this size required substantial memory or cloud computing resources. Now, everyday Mac users can execute powerful language models locally without expensive hardware or cloud subscriptions, while keeping their data private. This project exemplifies the ongoing democratization of AI — lowering the barrier to entry for developers, researchers, and hobbyists who want to experiment with state-of-the-art models on consumer hardware.

digest_items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
digest_items.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
digest_items.author: microsoft
digest_items.summary_zh: 微软推出的《AI for Beginners》课程是一套为期12周、共24课时的免费学习资源，专为零基础学习者设计。课程覆盖机器学习、神经网络、计算机视觉等核心主题，结合实践项目，帮助初学者系统掌握人工智能基础。无论学生还是转行者，都能借此轻松入门AI领域。
digest_items.summary_en: Microsoft's AI for Beginners is a free, structured curriculum that spans 12 weeks with 24 lessons, covering essential AI topics like machine learning, neural networks, and computer vision. It's designed for absolute beginners, offering hands-on projects and clear explanations. This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. It's a perfect starting point for anyone curious about artificial intelligence.

digest_items.title: The coolest use for the Vision Pro
digest_items.author: robbiet480
digest_items.summary_zh: Hacker News 热帖认为 Vision Pro 最酷的用法是当随身多屏工作台：连接 Mac 后投射出多个虚拟屏幕，用于编程或设计，而不是玩沉浸视频。评论区的开发者普遍认可这一生产力定位，但也吐槽佩戴舒适度和电池续航仍是硬伤。适合正在评估空间计算设备价值的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: A Hacker News thread argues the Vision Pro's coolest use is as a portable multi-monitor workstation: pair it with a Mac and project several virtual displays for coding or design, not immersive video. Developers in the comments mostly agree that productivity beats entertainment here, despite complaints about comfort and battery. Worth reading if you're evaluating Apple's spatial computer.

digest_items.title: 7.1 Earthquake in Japan
digest_items.author: krembo
digest_items.summary_zh: 日本发生7.1级地震，震感强烈，但未引发严重海啸。这次事件再次凸显了地震预警系统的重要性，以及日本在防灾科技方面的领先地位。对于科技行业而言，这也是检验各种通信和监测设备实际性能的契机。
digest_items.summary_en: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake shook Japan with strong tremors, but did not trigger a major tsunami. The event once again underscores the importance of earthquake early warning systems and Japan's leadership in disaster prevention technology. For the tech industry, it also serves as a real-world test of various communication and monitoring devices.

digest_items.title: 别再裸用 Claude Code 了！32 个亲测Skills + 8 个 MCP，开发效率直接拉满！
digest_items.description: 别再裸用 Claude Code 了！32 个亲测技能 + 8 个 MCP 服务器，开发效率直接拉满！ 先晒一下我装完的效果（见下图），所有技能均实测可用。
digest_items.summary_zh: 一位开发者亲测了32个Claude Code实用技能和8个MCP服务器，整理出一套完整的效率提升方案。这些技能覆盖代码补全、重构、调试等关键环节，配合MCP服务器实现任务自动化，让AI编程助手从玩具变成真正的生产力工具。文章强调所有技能均已真实可用，不是理论堆砌，适合所有使用Claude Code的开发者直接上手。
digest_items.summary_en: A developer tested 32 practical Claude Code skills and 8 MCP servers, compiling a comprehensive guide to boost coding efficiency. These skills cover code completion, refactoring, and debugging, while the MCP servers automate repetitive tasks, transforming Claude Code from a gimmick into a real productivity tool. The author emphasizes that all tips have been verified in practice, making this resource valuable for any developer looking to get the most out of their AI coding assistant.

digest_items.title: Read this before you buy that TV streaming stick
digest_items.author: speckx
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章建议购买电视棒前先看清三个隐藏成本：系统占用可用的存储空间、系统更新周期决定设备寿命、主页会推送广告。它对比了 Roku、Fire TV 和 Google TV 的长期体验，认为低价格并不等于低总拥有成本。适合准备购买电视盒子的用户。
digest_items.summary_en: This article warns that cheap streaming sticks come with hidden costs: system files eat available storage, OS updates have a limited lifespan, and home screens show ads. It compares Roku, Fire TV, and Google TV on long-term experience, arguing that a low upfront price doesn't mean low total ownership. A must-read before picking a living-room device.

digest_items.title: Superlogical
digest_items.author: yan
digest_items.summary_zh: Superlogical是一个通过自然语言描述来自动化逻辑推理和流程编排的工具。用户只需用简单的语言说明需求，它就能自动生成可执行的逻辑规则，适合处理复杂的决策树或业务规则。对于那些需要快速验证算法正确性，或者要在系统中嵌入逻辑推理能力的人来说，Superlogical降低了门槛。它像是一个懂你意图的逻辑引擎，把繁琐的规则编写变成对话式的体验。
digest_items.summary_en: Superlogical is a tool that turns natural language descriptions into executable logic rules and workflows. Instead of manually coding complex decision trees or business rules, you simply describe what you want, and it handles the translation. This makes it a game‑changer for developers and analysts who need to quickly prototype or embed reasoning capabilities into their systems. It lowers the barrier for automating logic, transforming a traditionally tedious task into a conversational interaction. Think of it as a logic engine that understands your intent and builds the rules for you.

digest_items.title: usekaneo/kaneo
digest_items.description: 🎯 All you need. Nothing you don't. Open source project management that works for you, not against you.
digest_items.author: usekaneo
digest_items.summary_zh: Kaneo 是一个开源项目管理工具，以“所需即所得”为理念，强调极简界面和不冗余的功能设计。它适合希望摆脱重型软件、需要轻量自托管方案的个人开发者或小团队，注重让工具适配用户流程而非相反。
digest_items.summary_en: Kaneo is an open-source project management tool built on a minimalist philosophy, offering only essential features without unnecessary clutter. It targets developers and small teams who prefer a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to heavier project management suites. The project emphasizes adapting to user workflows rather than forcing users to adapt to the tool.

digest_items.title: Stacked PRs are now live on GitHub
digest_items.author: tomzorz
digest_items.summary_zh: GitHub 今日正式上线堆叠 PR（stacked pull requests）功能，允许把相互依赖的多个 PR 按依赖关系排列成栈，逐层合并。这样大改动可以拆成多个小提交独立评审，适合在长生命周期分支上协作的团队，能明显减少等待和冲突。
digest_items.summary_en: GitHub has officially launched stacked pull requests, allowing developers to group multiple dependent PRs into a stack and merge them in order. This approach lets large changes be split into smaller, independently reviewable commits, which matters for teams on long-lived branches. The feature is now live for all users.

digest_items.title: The session you cannot take with you
digest_items.author: apitman
digest_items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 Web 会话的本质：服务端把会话状态绑定在用户当前浏览器，用户一旦离开或关闭标签页，这个会话就无法再被带走或恢复。它剖析了无状态 HTTP 下认证的边界问题，适合前后端开发者思考登录态设计与会话安全。
digest_items.summary_en: This piece examines the ephemeral nature of web sessions: the server ties session state to the user's current browser, so leaving the site or closing the tab makes that session impossible to carry over or restore. It unpacks authentication boundaries under stateless HTTP, useful for developers designing login flows and session security.

digest_items.title: KOReader
digest_items.author: Cider9986
digest_items.summary_zh: 这款开源引擎能让任何搭载 M 系列芯片的 Mac 仅用 2GB 内存就跑动 Gemma 4 26B 大语言模型。通过极致的量化与内存优化技术，它打破了本地运行大型 AI 模型的高硬件门槛，让普通 Mac 用户也能尝试前沿研究。对于 AI 爱好者、学生和预算有限的开发者来说，这是一个令人兴奋的突破，意味着更低的实验成本和更便捷的本地推理体验。
digest_items.summary_en: This open-source engine makes it possible to run the large language model Gemma 4 26B on any M-series Mac with just 2GB of RAM. Through aggressive quantization and memory optimization, it lowers the hardware barrier for running cutting-edge AI locally. This is a game-changer for AI enthusiasts, students, and developers with limited resources, enabling them to experiment and develop applications without expensive cloud GPUs or high-end workstations.

digest_items.title: Prelint
digest_items.description: Prevent product drift in AI-written code
digest_items.summary_zh: Prelint是一款专门防止AI生成代码出现“产品漂移”的检查工具。当AI编写的代码虽然语法正确却偏离了业务需求时，Prelint能通过自定义规则和语义分析提前拦截这类问题。它特别适合在使用Copilot、Codex等AI编码助手的团队中充当质检关口，确保生成的代码不仅跑得通，还能真正满足产品需求。对于想放心利用AI提速又不想牺牲产品质量的开发者来说，Prelint是缺不了的安全网。
digest_items.summary_en: Prelint is a linter purpose‑built for AI‑generated code, tackling the growing problem of product drift—where code compiles and runs but subtly strays from business requirements. It uses custom rules and semantic analysis to catch these mismatches before they hit production. For teams relying on AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex, Prelint acts as a quality gate, ensuring the output aligns with actual product intent. Developers who want to accelerate with AI without sacrificing accuracy will find it an indispensable safety net. It bridges the gap between fast code generation and reliable software delivery.

digest_items.title: SKI
digest_items.description: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
digest_items.summary_zh: SKI是一款免费语音编程工具，支持Claude Code、Codex等主流AI编程助手，让开发者直接用自然语言口述代码指令，无需动手输入。它解决了程序员因键盘操作导致的肢体疲劳问题，同时也为行动不便的群体提供了更友好的编程方式。最吸引人的是它完全免费，降低了尝试门槛，是追求高效无障碍编程体验者的实用选择。
digest_items.summary_en: SKI is a free voice coding tool that works with popular AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex, letting developers dictate commands and code instructions naturally instead of typing. It addresses common issues like repetitive strain injuries and accessibility barriers, making programming more inclusive and comfortable. The fact that it's free lowers the entry barrier significantly, so anyone curious about hands-free development can simply plug it in and start speaking. For developers with physical discomfort or those just wanting a more ergonomic workflow, SKI offers a practical and approachable solution.

digest_items.title: Memmy Agent
digest_items.description: Let every AI remember the same you.
digest_items.summary_zh: Memmy Agent致力于解决AI记忆碎片化的问题，它创建一个统一的用户记忆层，让不同的AI助手和工具都能记住同一个你。无论你使用ChatGPT、Claude还是其他AI产品，你的偏好、背景信息和上下文都能被共享，从而获得高度个性化的连贯体验。对于重度AI用户和追求跨平台一致性的专业人士来说，这款工具能极大提升效率，减少重复介绍和重新设置带来的麻烦。
digest_items.summary_en: Memmy Agent builds a unified memory layer that lets every AI tool remember the same version of you. Instead of each chatbot or assistant starting from scratch, your preferences, background details, and context are shared across platforms, so the experience feels continuous and genuinely personal. This solves a common frustration for heavy AI users who constantly have to repeat themselves or lose important context when switching tools. Professionals who juggle multiple AI assistants in daily workflows will benefit the most, as Memmy reduces redundancy and makes every interaction more informed and tailored. It's an elegant step toward making AI truly understand you, not just handle isolated requests.

digest_items.title: paperswithbacktest/awesome-systematic-trading
digest_items.description: A curated list of awesome libraries, packages, strategies, books, blogs, tutorials for systematic trading.
digest_items.author: paperswithbacktest
digest_items.summary_zh: 这是一个系统性交易资源合集，整理了量化交易相关的库、策略、书籍、博客和教程，覆盖回测、风险管理、数据获取等模块。无论你是刚入门还是想找成熟实现，这个列表都按主题组织好了资源，可以省去大量检索时间。
digest_items.summary_en: This curated list aggregates systematic trading resources, including libraries, strategies, books, blogs, and tutorials, spanning backtesting, risk management, and data sourcing. Organized by topic, it helps both beginners and experienced quants quickly find reliable implementations and reference material without extensive searching. The collection is on GitHub and updated by the community.

digest_items.title: AI Search Console
digest_items.description: Prompt analytics and citation mapping for AI search
digest_items.summary_zh: AI Search Console是一款专门为AI搜索时代打造的提示词分析和引用映射工具。它能帮助品牌和内容创作者追踪自己的内容在ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索引擎中被引用的情况，查看哪些提示词触发了品牌提及，以及竞争对手的可见度如何。对于SEO专业人员、内容营销人员和关注品牌在线影响力的人来说，这是一款极具针对性的数据洞察平台。
digest_items.summary_en: AI Search Console provides prompt analytics and citation mapping for the fast-growing world of AI-powered search. It lets brands and content creators see exactly how their material gets referenced inside AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Perplexity, which prompts trigger brand appearances, and how they compare to competitors. This addresses the emerging challenge of tracking visibility in answer engines rather than traditional Google results. For SEO professionals, content marketers, and brand managers who want to understand their footprint in the AI search landscape, this tool offers essential clarity and actionable data in one focused dashboard.

digest_items.title: SoundGate Guitar
digest_items.description: AI Music Tutor that gives real-time feedback on your playing
digest_items.summary_zh: SoundGate Guitar是一款AI音乐导师，它能够在用户弹奏吉他时实时分析音准、节奏和技巧，并给出精准的纠正建议。对于初学者来说，这相当于拥有了一个24小时在线的私人教练，无需再依赖昂贵的线下课程。而进阶玩家也能通过它发现细微的演奏瑕疵，提升表现力。这款工具巧妙地将人工智能与音乐教育结合，解决了传统自学缺乏即时反馈的痛点，让练琴变得高效又有趣。
digest_items.summary_en: SoundGate Guitar is an AI music tutor that provides real-time feedback on your guitar playing. It analyzes pitch, rhythm, and technique as you play, offering instant corrections and suggestions. For beginners, this eliminates the need for expensive in-person lessons, giving them a personal coach available around the clock. Advanced players can use it to refine subtle imperfections and improve expressiveness. By combining artificial intelligence with music education, SoundGate solves the core problem of self-learning—the lack of immediate feedback—making practice sessions both effective and engaging.

digest_items.title: Claude Code usage tracking by LangWatch
digest_items.description: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
digest_items.summary_zh: LangWatch 新推出的工具专门为 Claude Code 会话提供成本追踪服务，让开发者清楚知道每次编码会话实际花了多少钱。它能拆解 API 调用、token 消耗和耗时，帮助个人开发者或团队更好地控制 AI 编程预算，优化使用效率。对于重度依赖 Claude Code 的用户来说，这是一款非常实用的成本管理利器。
digest_items.summary_en: LangWatch has launched a new tool that tracks the real cost of your Claude Code sessions, breaking down API calls, token usage, and time spent. It helps developers and teams understand exactly what they're spending on AI coding, so they can manage budgets and optimize usage more effectively. For anyone relying heavily on Claude Code, this is a handy cost-control layer that turns vague anxiety about bills into clear, actionable data.

digest_items.title: iv-org/invidious
digest_items.description: Invidious is an alternative front-end to YouTube
digest_items.author: iv-org
digest_items.summary_zh: Invidious 是一个开源的 YouTube 替代前端，允许用户在没有广告和跟踪的情况下观看视频，同时保留订阅、播放列表等核心功能。它也能配合 Tor 或代理使用，适合注重隐私以及希望自建 YouTube 客户端的用户。
digest_items.summary_en: Invidious is an open-source alternative front-end to YouTube that lets you watch videos without ads and tracking, while still supporting subscriptions, playlists, and other core features. It can also be used through Tor or a proxy. This is ideal for privacy-conscious users or anyone who wants to self-host their own YouTube client.

digest_items.title: MiniMax H3
digest_items.description: Unified video generation for motion design and branding
digest_items.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布统一视频生成模型 H3，面向动态设计与品牌视觉，用户可通过文本或图片生成带品牌风格的动效片段。它把动态图形和品牌规范整合在同一条生成流程里，省去人工调整和多次渲染，适合设计团队快速产出营销素材。
digest_items.summary_en: MiniMax launches H3, a unified video generation model focused on motion design and branding. It lets users create brand-consistent animated clips from text or images, merging motion graphics and brand guidelines into one pipeline. Useful for design teams that need fast marketing or ad assets.

digest_items.title: Denovo
digest_items.description: Turn your vibe-coded app into paying customers
digest_items.summary_zh: Denovo是一款帮助开发者把vibe coding快速搭建出的应用转化为实际收入的工具。很多用自然语言生成的代码原型往往停留在demo阶段，Denovo提供支付、订阅、用户管理等商业化功能集成，让这些应用能够轻松实现收费闭环。对于独立开发者、创业团队以及AI产品爱好者来说，这是连接创意原型与可持续商业模式的桥梁，能显著加速产品变现过程并验证市场价值。
digest_items.summary_en: Denovo helps developers turn vibe-coded apps—those quickly built with natural language prompts—into actual sources of revenue. While many such prototypes never leave the demo stage, Denovo provides easy integration for payments, subscriptions, user management, and other monetization essentials, completing the leap from fun experiment to viable business. It's designed for indie hackers, startup founders, and AI enthusiasts who want to validate their ideas without wrestling with complex billing infrastructure. By removing the friction around getting paid, Denovo lets builders focus on what they care about: making a product people love. This is a legitimate bridge between rapid AI-assisted creation and sustainable commercial success.

digest_items.title: NINA
digest_items.description: Guide users step by step inside your product.
digest_items.summary_zh: NINA 是一个产品内引导工具，用于在应用界面中制作分步式新手教程和操作提示。它支持通过可视化配置快速上线引导流程，帮助新用户理解核心功能，适合产品团队优化激活与留存。
digest_items.summary_en: NINA is an in-app guidance tool for building step-by-step onboarding tours and interactive tips directly inside your product. It offers a visual configuration workflow so product managers can launch guides without heavy code changes, helping improve activation and user retention.

digest_items.title: /mission for Claude Code
digest_items.description: Give Claude Code missions to spawn a team of agents
digest_items.summary_zh: /mission 为 Claude Code 增加了一条斜杠命令，允许用户定义一项“使命”并自动派生出多个子代理并行处理代码任务。它适用于大型代码库的重构、跨文件修改和多模块测试，让 Claude Code 从单线程问答变成可编排的多代理协作。
digest_items.summary_en: /mission is a slash command for Claude Code that lets you set a mission and automatically spawn a team of sub-agents to work in parallel. It's designed for large-scale refactoring, cross-file edits, or multi-module testing, scaling Claude Code from one-off chatbot responses to coordinated agent workflows.

digest_items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
digest_items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
digest_items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
digest_items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

digest_items.title: 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
digest_items.description: 真实的 AI 开发微信小游戏全流程记录：技术栈、prompt、踩坑清单、成本明细全公开。文末有彩蛋。
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章完整记录了一位开发者利用AI辅助技术从零构建并上线微信小游戏的全过程。作者毫无保留地公开了技术栈、提示词（prompt）设计、遇到的各类踩坑问题以及详细的成本明细，甚至附有彩蛋。对于想尝试用AI加速小游戏开发但又缺乏经验的团队或个人来说，这篇实战复盘提供了真实可参考的路线图和避坑指南，展现了AI在降低开发门槛方面的巨大潜力。
digest_items.summary_en: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of building and launching a WeChat mini game entirely with AI assistance. The author shares everything from the technology stack and prompt engineering techniques to a detailed breakdown of costs and a list of common pitfalls encountered during the process, ending with a hidden bonus. For indie developers or small teams curious about leveraging AI to speed up game development, this real-world case study serves as an invaluable reference. It demonstrates how AI tools can dramatically lower the barrier to entry for game creation, making it accessible even to those without a deep coding background.

digest_items.title: [程序员] deepseek-v4-flash-0731 感觉把国产模型价格打穿了，还买啥 coding plan。
digest_items.summary_zh: V2EX 用户发帖称 DeepSeek 的 V4 Flash 0731 模型 API 价格低到击穿国产模型市场，让包月制的编程助手订阅看起来不再划算。评论区在估算按量计费的实际成本，不少人认为这类模型将替代 Copilot 等付费方案。适合关注 AI 落地成本的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: A V2EX developer says DeepSeek's V4 Flash 0731 API pricing is so low it upends the domestic LLM market, making paid coding-plan subscriptions hard to justify. The thread estimates unit economics and coding quality, with many predicting usage-based billing will replace monthly copilot plans. Worth a look for developers budgeting AI tooling.

digest_items.title: [分享创造] 做了一个在线反应、记忆与专注力测试网站
digest_items.summary_zh: 该网站是个人开发者近日上线的 Web 应用，包含反应时、数字记忆、专注度等多项测试，无需安装即可在浏览器中完成。测试后提供结果对比和简单解读，适合想快速评估自身认知状态或做脑力小实验的用户。界面简洁，移动端可用。
digest_items.summary_en: A personal developer recently launched a browser-based cognitive testing site covering reaction time, memory span, and focus exercises. Users can complete tests instantly without installation, then see comparative scores and brief interpretation. This practical tool suits anyone curious about quick self-evaluation or simple brain training experiments. The interface is minimal and mobile-friendly.

digest_items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
digest_items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
digest_items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
digest_items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

digest_items.title: [Google] 感觉 Google DMCA 执行得比 Bing 要严？
digest_items.summary_zh: 用户在帖中对比两大搜索引擎对 DMCA 删除请求的响应差异，称 Google 在版权投诉处理上更严格，删除结果更快更全面，而 Bing 则相对宽松。这会影响站长和内容创作者对搜索流量的预期，尤其是涉及版权争议内容时。评论中有人指出 Google 的自动化系统也可能误删，需注意申诉渠道。
digest_items.summary_en: A user reports that Google handles DMCA takedown requests more strictly than Bing, with faster and more comprehensive removal of search results. This matters for webmasters and creators who rely on search traffic, particularly for copyright-sensitive material. Some commenters note Google's automated system may over-remove, so filing counter-notices is essential.

digest_items.title: [推广] 直供 Claude 等海外模型官网 key ，有需求的企业大厂来看看
digest_items.summary_zh: V2EX 上一则推广帖称可直供 Claude 等海外模型的官网 API key，客户群体以企业和大型厂商为主。帖子强调“直供”和“官网”，并声称有需求的企业“大厂”可联系。对需要合规获取海外模型 API 的团队或许有用，但需自行核实渠道资质，避免充值风险。
digest_items.summary_en: A promotional post on V2EX offers direct sourcing of official API keys for Claude and other overseas models, targeting enterprises and large companies. It stresses the 'official' channel and invites corporate buyers to get in touch. Teams should verify the vendor's credentials before committing, given potential payment and compliance risks.

digest_items.title: [问与答] ssh 管理工具求教
digest_items.summary_zh: 发帖者向社区询问 SSH 连接管理方案，期望替代自带终端或简化多主机管理。回帖中推荐了 Termius、FinalShell、Tabby 等跨平台工具，还有人建议用 Shell 脚本配合 ssh config 自定义。适合运维和经常需要连接多台服务器的开发者，选择时可以考虑是否支持密钥管理、同步和团队协作。
digest_items.summary_en: The poster asks for SSH client management tools, hoping to simplify working with multiple hosts. Commenters recommend cross-platform apps like Termius, FinalShell, and Tabby, while others suggest scripting with ssh config. Useful for DevOps engineers and developers who frequently manage servers — consider features like keychain storage, cloud sync, and team collaboration when choosing.

digest_items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
digest_items.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
digest_items.author: TencentCloud
digest_items.summary_zh: 腾讯云开源了 TencentDB-Agent-Memory，一个面向 AI Agent 团队的记忆中枢，能把对话、文档和代码转成 Chat Memory、Skill、LLM-Wiki、Code-Graph 四类可复用记忆资产。它强调统一治理和团队共享，适合构建多 Agent 协作系统的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: Tencent Cloud has released TencentDB-Agent-Memory, a team-level memory hub for AI agents. It converts conversations, documents, and code into four reusable assets: Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, and Code-Graph. The project focuses on governed, shared memory, making it useful for developers building multi-agent systems that need consistent context and tool knowledge across sessions.

digest_items.title: [分享创造] 做了个会把清单藏起来的 todo app
digest_items.summary_zh: 一款另类的 todo 应用，采用「先藏后看」的交互：清单默认收起来，需要时手动展开，从而让用户聚焦单条任务。对于待办列表很长又容易焦虑的人来说，这种设计能显著降低压力。
digest_items.summary_en: A newly shared todo app flips the usual list design: the entire list stays hidden until the user deliberately expands it, letting them focus on a single task. The author built it as a way to reduce visual clutter and anxiety, and it may appeal to people who feel overwhelmed by long to-do lists.

digest_items.title: [分享发现] 8 月份网易云音乐黑胶会员领取，天数随机
digest_items.summary_zh: 网易云音乐8月有一个黑胶会员领取活动正在进行，用户可以获得随机天数的VIP，具体时长因人而异。该活动由V2EX用户先行发现，帖子中提供了参与方式，感兴趣的话可以按提示去App里找入口。
digest_items.summary_en: A NetEase Cloud Music promotion for August lets users claim a black-vinyl VIP membership for free, with the number of days randomly assigned per account. The offer was first shared by a V2EX user, who also pointed to the in-app entry point. Since the campaign is clearly time-limited, anyone interested should act quickly before it disappears.

digest_items.title: [分享发现] 今天怎么回事？ x 都在发收益？
digest_items.summary_zh: 帖主观察到当天社交平台 X 上大量用户晒收益截图，似乎与某个活动或空投相关。评论中有人推测是加密货币激励或广告分成计划，也有网友表示只是集中炫耀。这条动态反映 X 平台近期在创作者变现上的新动作，适合关注社交平台生态变化的从业者留意。
digest_items.summary_en: The author notices an unusual wave of users on X posting earnings screenshots, possibly tied to a promotion or crypto airdrop. Commenters speculate about an incentive scheme or ad revenue program, while others see it as mere flexing. The thread highlights X’s recent shifts in creator monetization, relevant for those tracking social platform dynamics.

digest_items.title: [Wunder] V2EX AI Chat 可用模型列表新增 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 版本
digest_items.summary_zh: V2EX 的 AI Chat 功能在可用模型中加入了 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731，这是 DeepSeek 系列里的 Flash 变体，定位是更快的响应速度。该版本带有 0731 日期标记，可能针对某些任务做了优化，适合在聊天里快速测试或日常使用。
digest_items.summary_en: V2EX's AI Chat now includes DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 in its list of available models. As a Flash variant, it's designed for faster responses, and the 0731 date tag likely points to a newer snapshot. Users who want low-latency chat can try it from the model picker, making it a good fit for quick tasks or everyday questions.

digest_items.title: [汽车] 问一下大家： NOA/辅助驾驶 之类的，使用频率高吗？
digest_items.summary_zh: V2EX 汽车版块有车友发帖调查 NOA/辅助驾驶的真实使用频率，征集车主在通勤和长途场景下的开启习惯。这类讨论能反映智能辅助驾驶从尝鲜到日常依赖的渗透程度，对考虑选装智驾功能的潜在车主有参考价值。
digest_items.summary_en: A V2EX user in the car section asks how often drivers actually use NOA or other assisted-driving features in daily life. The thread collects real-world usage frequency on commutes and long trips. It offers a pragmatic snapshot of whether smart-driving features become habitual or stay as novelties, useful for prospective EV buyers.

digest_items.title: bytedance/deer-flow
digest_items.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
digest_items.author: bytedance
digest_items.summary_zh: 字节跳动开源了DeerFlow，一个面向长期任务的超级智能体框架。它能够自主进行研究、编码和创作，借助沙箱环境、记忆模块、工具调用、技能学习和子代理协作来应对复杂场景。对于需要构建可扩展AI工作流的开发者来说，这提供了一个灵活且强大的基础工具。
digest_items.summary_en: ByteDance open-sourced DeerFlow, a long-horizon SuperAgent framework that autonomously researches, codes, and creates. It leverages sandboxes, memory, tools, skills, and sub-agents to handle complex multi-step tasks, making it a powerful tool for developers building scalable AI workflows.

digest_items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
digest_items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
digest_items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

digest_items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
digest_items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
digest_items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
digest_items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

digest_items.title: microsoft/TRELLIS.2
digest_items.description: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation
digest_items.author: microsoft
digest_items.summary_zh: Microsoft 开源了 TRELLIS.2，一种面向 3D 生成的模型，使用原生紧凑的结构化潜空间代替传统体素或点云表示，可生成高质量 3D 资产。适合 3D 内容生成、游戏与仿真领域的开发者和研究者。
digest_items.summary_en: Microsoft has open-sourced TRELLIS.2, a 3D generation model that uses native and compact structured latents instead of conventional voxel or point-cloud representations. It yields high-quality 3D assets from text or images. Developers and researchers building 3D content pipelines, games, or simulations will want to evaluate it.

digest_items.title: github/copilot-sdk
digest_items.description: Multi-platform SDK for integrating GitHub Copilot Agent into apps and services
digest_items.author: github
digest_items.summary_zh: GitHub 发布官方 Copilot SDK，支持将 Copilot Agent 集成到桌面、Web 等各类应用中，提供跨平台能力。开发者可在自己的产品里直接调用 Copilot 的智能补全与对话功能，不必自己搭建模型链路。适合做 IDE 插件或 AI 助手类应用的团队评估。
digest_items.summary_en: GitHub has released an official Copilot SDK that lets developers integrate the Copilot Agent into desktop, web, and other applications with cross-platform support. It provides direct access to Copilot's code completion and chat capabilities without building a model pipeline from scratch. Worth evaluating for teams building IDE plugins or AI assistant products.

digest_items.title: 程序员副业 | 2026年4月复盘
digest_items.description: 我看后台有人催更，确实很久没写复盘了，年后一直在折腾，今天有时间，来复盘下4月份做的事情吧，最近真的是疯狂在通宵编程哈哈，今天我开发的软件发布了新版本，稍微可以清闲一下。
digest_items.summary_zh: 这是一位程序员分享的2026年4月副业复盘，作者回应读者催更，讲述了自己年后持续折腾、通宵编程开发软件并发布新版本的经历。文章展现了副业程序员面临的巨大时间投入与自我驱动力，同时也描述了新版本上线后的短暂轻松。对于同样在探索副业的开发者来说，这篇复盘既是一种共鸣，也是激励——持续投入终会带来可见的成果。
digest_items.summary_en: A programmer shares their side project recap for April 2026, responding to readers who urged an update. The author describes an intense period of coding overnight after the new year, finally releasing a new version of their software. This post highlights the significant time commitment and self-discipline required for side projects, along with the fleeting relief of shipping a release. For developers juggling side hustles, this recap resonates deeply—it shows that sustained effort eventually pays off with tangible progress and a momentary break.

digest_items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
digest_items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
digest_items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
digest_items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

digest_items.title: 2026 了，前端转 AI 全栈我是这么学的 😍😍😍
digest_items.description: 最近，"前端已死，全栈永生" 又开始在技术圈流行。 支付宝体验技术部已经解散并完成拆分，原有人员分流到各条业务线。这件事传开以后，很多人又往下推一步，变成 "前端作为独立工种肯定会消失"。 更准确的事
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章从支付宝体验技术部解散说起，讨论“前端已死”背后的真实趋势，并给出前端转 AI 全栈的学习路线。作者认为前端作为独立工种不会消失，但技能栈需要重构，还分享了具体的项目实践建议。适合因为裁员焦虑的前端开发者读一读。
digest_items.summary_en: This article uses the disbanding of Alipay's Experience Technology Department to analyze the real trend behind the 'frontend is dead' claim, then maps out a learning path from frontend to AI full-stack development. The author argues that frontend as a separate job won't vanish but its skill stack must be rebuilt, and offers concrete project suggestions. It's a useful read for frontend developers anxious about layoffs.

digest_items.title: 普通程序员有没有必要学习 Agent 开发？
digest_items.description: 大家好，我是双越。wangEditor 作者，前百度 滴滴 资深前端工程师，慕课网金牌讲师，PMP，前端面试派作者。本文讨论普通程序员要不要学习 AI Agent 开发。
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章由资深前端工程师双越撰写，探讨普通程序员是否需要学习AI Agent开发。作者结合自身经验，分析了Agent开发对程序员职业发展的潜在影响，认为虽然并非所有人必须立刻投身其中，但了解这一趋势有助于在AI浪潮中保持竞争力。文章引发了对技术路线选择的深度思考。
digest_items.summary_en: In this article, senior front-end engineer Shuangyue discusses whether ordinary programmers should learn AI Agent development. Drawing from his own experience, he analyzes the potential impact on career growth, arguing that while not everyone needs to dive in immediately, understanding this trend helps stay competitive in the AI wave. The piece sparks deep reflection on technology path choices.
